newsitems.title: Assassin's Creed in Haven
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ab0e909119db422e3b5266756b7c5403d1ef9dbb.jpg[/img]

Hello Brothers and Survivors,

The largest multinational corporation entity - Abstergo Industries - of Assassin's Creed has established a temporary facility in Haven of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS: so we want you, an Assassin of the Assassin Brotherhood, to find out what they're up to this time and prevent Abstergo's influence from spreading even further.

During the #19.1 update, it'll be your job to land on Haven, break into Abstergo Industries, and survive till the end through stealth exploration of the sector's silent depths. Several in-game Assassin costumes to help furtive actions are also available at the Store, so check them out before you head out.

Lastly, here's a few heads up on what you'll be facing once you dive down on Haven.

[b]Haven: Abstergo Industries[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bd25dd8e3040f42925791270c7d3b9b5219b0947.jpg[/img]

On the plane to Haven, make sure to plan to land between Steel Mill and Residential to infiltrate Abstergo Industries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/77f57708dbaab80202df823aa1a6799c17d0d91d.jpg[/img]

One of the values of the Assassin Brotherhood may be to "stay your blade from the flesh of an innocent," but be aware that a single innocent being does not exist on the Battlegrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/72c7d3d3f9ce7f5b802fcad5a859f2c9ee2a1f7c.jpg[/img]

[b]How Long Will They Stay?[/b]

We've been told the temporary Abstergo Industries facility will take root in Haven for a certain period only. Make sure to accomplish all deeds before then.

[b]Collaborative Items: Assassin's Creed[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d226ea8dc681cd0d7a978a27a0b544cfd54744ce.jpg[/img]

Gain courage from Master Assassin Ezio Auditore da Firenze's and Syrian Assassin Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad's costumes, available for purchase at the Store. To further enrichen your upcoming endeavor, obtain bonus backpack skins, emote, sprays, and more with the Assassin's Creed All-in-One Bundle.

newsitems.title: "DESTON RISE" Live Streaming Event with Neymar Jr.
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9ede4f35de6d4c28d0f4c9a9b2bfa4440beaf500.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

Neymar Jr. has finally landed in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS! He’ll be playing PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS with and against our partners through live streaming sessions, and various events are in plan straight from the live studio! Also, all viewers from our Twitch Official Channel will get the chance to win prizes just by watching the live stream! So don’t miss out! Tchu Tchu Tcha!
[h2][b]Match Ruleset[/b][/h2]
[h3]“King of the Hill” (Lodge Defense) – Two Matches[/h3]
Brazil national football team and Paris Saint-Germain F.C’s number 10, a.k.a Neyma”ru” in South Korea! Neymar Jr. and his squad, made up of our LATAM regional influencers and official partners, are coming to Deston!

During the event, Neymar’s squad will only be eligible to loot in the Lodge area of Deston. However, to give them a little compensation, we will allow the squad to select extra weapons that they desire.

All they have to do is let Neymar succeed in hitting particular targets with his ball in the studio before the match starts. If he does, the selected weapons will spawn in the Lodge area.

Other partners can only loot outside the Lodge area and are limited to using Melee weapons, Crossbows, or Pistols. On the other hand, Tactical Gear, boost, and heal items are free to use.

The Blue Zone will slowly tighten into the Lodge area. Can Neymar and his squad become king of the hill? There will be two rounds of the hill shooter battle. Watch to see who becomes king!

[h3]8-man Squad Classic Battle Royale – One Match [/h3]
We also have a match with the classic battle royale rules in plan. All players will be limited to level one gear to maximize the thrill. However, Neymar will be the only one to have access to level 3 gear and Self-AED.

To give our official partners an extra handicap, Neymar will kick the ball again in the studio. He’ll get the chance to decide which weapons other partners will use if he hits the target!

Calling attention to all players!

Today we’re here to guide you on how you can get the most out of our Partner Drops and this month’s perks.

Watch our partners’ streams for the times below and win your July rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7b9661afadf34c7848a51b3dd0c24bccacc196f3.png[/img]

[h2][b]How to Participate[/b][/h2][h3]KRAFTON Account[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9e4884f8774e6bdbd5d0f0172c2f31ea1cd65c30.png[/img]

First and foremost, you’ll need a KRAFTON account (if you don’t have one already). A KRAFTON account is a KRAFTON-exclusive account (as distinct from a PUBG account) where you can receive various news from KRAFTON games.

Go to PUBG.COM and press the Login button (upper right corner) to sign in/sign up right away!
[h3]Link Your Account[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5daf716e10ae6d2437f63b52c257e5b25142326e.png[/img]

After signing in to your KRAFTON account, you’ll need to link your game AND stream platform accounts to successfully participate in our Partner Drops. (Please be aware account-linking methods may vary per platform, so make sure to follow the provided instructions carefully!)
[h3]Check Out Drops Missions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5ef2cb9711e1fe3c7bcd8ae0707e8c6b45afb1d7.png[/img]

Now it’s time to complete various missions and earn those Drops! There are two ways to check out what missions are available:
[list]    [*]Read the monthly Drops announcements on PUBG.COM.[/*]    [*]Access your streaming platform (ex. Twitch) → select the PUBG category in the Browse menu → Watch streams that have the “Drops Enabled” label![/*][/list]

[h3]Watching Conditions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/913b9374fd55a40af7e4546e0c17b6c31dab2509.png[/img]

Once you choose your favorite PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Partner’s streaming channel to watch, all you need to do is fulfill the requirements for the rewards! Once you satisfy the conditions, the Claim button automatically appears at the bottom. You can claim your rewards by clicking the button.

[h3]Check Your Rewards[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/93fda9b85e72fac0548913223ece3c53fdfd0e31.png[/img]

Go to the Customize menu to check out your Drops rewards. If you haven’t received them, please make sure all your accounts are properly linked and you have clicked the Claim button from the stream.

Here are some notes to keep in mind for Partner Drops:

※ You’ll be able to receive drops through our PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Partners only.

※ Rewards are only obtainable during the Drops period.

※ To receive the rewards, you must have a KRAFTON ID and link it to your gaming platform AND Twitch/each region’s streaming platform.

※ Korea, China, and Thailand viewers will be receiving redeem codes instead of drops due to their different streaming platforms.

※ Items can be acquired after the Live Server Update on Console platforms.

※ Hunter’s Chest reward is limited to Twitch streams only.

Check out the participating Partner channels from the link below now!

newsitems.title: Special Summer Event for Steam: Check-In for Hot Rewards!
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/351eaf5574bd7b3da830718eb83a3b0f938e8f0d.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

In need of a refresher amongst this sizzling weather? (Or some warmth if you’re on the other side of the globe?)

Two special summer events, [b]Check-in to Survive[/b] and [b]Play & Earn Survival Points[/b] are here this week to hand out exciting rewards: a Mini14 skin, Contraband Coupons, costumes and more!

All you need to do is check-in, play, and receive! Let’s find out more below.

※ Due to technical issues, the events below are available to [b]PC Steam users only[/b]. However, a check-in event (identical rewards) for Console users is coming up in our July Special Drops so check out the details there!

[h3]Event #1: Check-In to Survive[/h3]
Access the game everyday and earn a permanent Summer Surf – Mini14 skin! But watch out, as each day you do [u]not[/u] check in will have your distributed event “♥ (Life)” get depleted!

[h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3]

※ The time and dates below are subject to change.

[list]    [*]PDT: July 13, 2 AM – July 27, 1:59 AM[/*]    [*]CEST: July 13, 11 AM – July 27, 10:59 AM[/*]    [*]KST: July 13, 6 PM – July 27, 5:59 PM[/*][/list]

[h3][b]How the Event Works[/b][/h3][olist]    [*]Access PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS within the period shown above.[/*]    [*]Press the Special Summer Event banner in the lobby. The banner will take you to the event website.[/*]    [*]Click the Join Event button [b]within the first week of the event period[/b]and you will instantly receive 3 ♥.[olist]            [*]The Join Event button will be disabled starting from Day 8. Make sure to participate within the first 7 days for that permanent reward![/*]        [/olist]    [/*]    [*]Scroll down and make sure to press the [b]Check-In button[/b]to receive your daily ♥ as well![olist]            [*]You will then receive [b]Summer Surf – Mini14 (3 days), [/b]available in your CUSTOMIZE tab.[/*]        [/olist]    [/*]    [*]You can extend the time-limited use of Summer Surf – Mini14 by checking in every day.[/*]    [*]To change your 3-day Mini14 skin to a [b]permanent item[/b], you must make sure your ♥ [b]does not drop to 0[/b]during the event period and until the event’s last day.[olist]            [*]Access the event website any time through the lobby banner to check out your current ♥ and check-in progress.[/*]        [/olist]    [/*]    [*]Press the Check-In button at the event website each day and receive 1 ♥ [b]per [/b]check-in![olist]            [*]1 ♥ will get [b]depleted [/b]per day you [b]do not[/b] check-in.[/*]            [*]The Check-In button will reset at [u]UTC 9 AM / PDT 2 AM / CEST 11 AM[/u] per day.[/*]        [/olist]    [/*][/olist]

[h3][b]Reward[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/146e0a38b3cf04bd69c232611f34f718cd42467a.jpg[/img]



Summer Surf – Mini14
[list]    [*]If you succeed in maintaining more than 1 ♥, your permanent Summer Surf – Mini14 skin will be distributed to your CUSTOMIZE tab as soon as the event ends (and by July 29 UTC the latest).[/*][/list][h3]Event #2: Play & Earn Survival Points[/h3]
Check-in daily at the event website, play a match for at least 30 minutes, receive points, and exchange them for various in-game rewards at the Survival Point Shop!

The banner will take you to the event website.[/*]    [*]Click the Join Event button (if you haven’t already for Event 1).[/*]    [*]Scroll down and press the Check-In button for your daily check-in.[list]            [*]The Check-In button will reset at [u]UTC 9 AM / PDT 2 AM / CEST 11 AM[/u] per day.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Go back to PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS and play at least 30 minutes.[list]            [*]Your check-in will be counted when your cumulative time of survival/spectating teammates reach at least 30 minutes per day. newsitems.title: Patch Notes - Update 18.2
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6edd685ef7e680110cd18872d1f31a6c43f3d78c.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]18.2 Highlights[/b][/h2]        
To be updated on July 12 UTC.
        [h2][b]Live Maintenance Schedule[/b][/h2]        [list]            [*]PC[list]                    [*]PDT: July 12, 5:30 PM – July 13, 1:30 AM[/*]                    [*]CEST: July 13, 2:30 AM – 10:30 AM[/*]                    [*]KST: July 13, 9:30 AM – 5:30 PM[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Console[list]                    [*]PDT: July 20, 9 PM – July 21, 4 AM[/*]                    [*]CEST: July 21, 6 AM – 1 PM[/*]                    [*]KST: July 21, 1 PM – 8 PM[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]        [h2][b]Map Service[/b][/h2]        [list]            [*][b]Test Server: Normal Match[/b]                [list]                    [*]Miramar / Karakin[list]                            [*]AS region: Squad – TPP[/*]                            [*]NA region: Squad – FPP[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Test Server: Featured Map[/b]                [list]                    [*]Deston[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Live Server: Normal Match[/b]                [list]                    [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Sanhok / <s>Paramo</s> → [b]Karakin[/b][/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Live Server: Featured Map[/b]                [list]                    [*][b]Deston[/b][/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Live Server: Ranked[/b]                [list]                    [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]        

[b]※ [b]Please keep in mind the features and updates shown below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b][/b]

 [h2][b]New Map: Deston[/b][/h2]    

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/KIKI-1024x1014.png[/img]

 The wait is over. Our 9th new map we’ve been teasing about all this time is finally here this update. Welcome to the 8x8km near-future and ravaged world: [b]Deston[/b]!
        
Deston (formerly known as “Codename: Kiki”) presents you diverse biomes – a flooded downtown embracing one of the tallest skyscrapers you’ve ever seen in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, a murky swamp, clear coasts, beautiful mountains, and unexplored islands.
        
Check out our Deston website [b]here [/b]to go on a VR map tour(July 13th UTC) and delve more into the unknown before its live server release.
        [list]            [*]Deston is…[list]                    [*]Available as a Featured Map.[/*]                    [*]Playable in TPP and FPP.[list]                            [*]Solo, Duos, Squads (including 1-Man Squads) available.[/*]                            [*]Available modes may vary per region.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]Available in Custom Matches and Sandbox Mode (PC).[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Bots may spawn in Deston.[/*]            [*]Available vehicles: Pickup, Dacia, Coupe RB, Motorbike, Dirt Bike, Roadster Motorcycle, Quad, Buggy, Boat, Aquarail, and Airboat.[/*]            [*]The Flare Gun, DP-28, S12K, G36C, QBU, QBZ, K2, Sticky Bomb, Mortar, Lynx AMR, 15x Scope will [b]not [/b]spawn in Deston.[/*]            [*]A few points of interest[list]                    [*][b]Ripton[/b]: The overflow of water has submerged this sprawling city… players will have to wade through shallow water to pass through while always having to be on the alert for enemies lurking at the highest levels of surrounding skyscrapers. Here, you can travel seamlessly from the ground to the sky and back down again with tall buildings! But to prevent snipers from being too advantageous, we’ve made sure not every building here is accessible. (ex. Some buildings may only have a single floor accessible.)[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e2745fcbe4f54bfc0e54c2510aa15b60eccf6782.jpg[/img]

   [list]            [*][b]Swamp[/b]: Take a stroll through some trees, grass, and houses built along the water and enjoy a suspenseful cat and mouse with your enemies knee-deep in water![/*]        [/list]        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/34c9ce76a37b744c908d212d922ee373c3e334a0.jpg[/img]

     [list]            [*][b]Concert[/b]: An outdoor concert festival grounds where you’re free to strut some dance moves before heading out to fight for that Chicken Dinner.[/*]        [/list]        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9a2bda797a7200c5933a80fb514ad37bf662d1ad.jpg[/img]

        [list]            [*][b]Hydroelectric Dam[/b]: This area was once used as one of the green methods for generating power in Deston.[/*]            [*][b]Assembly:[/b] Observe how wind turbines are made here at the Assembly![/*]            [*][b]Arena[/b]: Don’t let all the entertainment at this paintball arena distract you too much from your main purpose.[/*]        [/list]     

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/68891f10c5133ff8324ffe707b6da98db5f6fcc8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Map Utility Items[/b][/h3]      
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS has a variety of special items that can be looted and consumed to create interesting gameplay.
        
Therefore, to prompt even more diversified plays, we are introducing players who enter Deston to the new [b]Map Utility Items[/b]. These items will trigger special in-game interactions depending on the situation, which are expected to provide a new core game flow without breaking player immersion.
        [list]            [*][b]Map Utility Items…[/b]                [list]                    [*]Will be placed in your Inventory once you enter Deston.[/*]                    [*]Will not be consumed on use and may be used as many times as you wish.[/*]                    [*]Will not affect Inventory weight.[/*]                    [*]Can [b]not [/b]be dropped from the Inventory.[/*]                    [*]Can [b]not [/b]be swapped with other Inventory items.[/*]                    [*]Will occupy their own Inventory slot.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Available Map Utility Items[list]                    [*][b]Ascender Attachment[/b]                        [list]                            [*]Allows you to use any Ascender as often as they want.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*][b]Utility Parachute[/b]                        [list]                            [*]Looks exactly like the Emergency Parachute.[/*]                            [*]Can be activated by pressing the Interaction key after jumping off a certain height.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Keys[/b][/*]        [/list]                    [table]                                    [tr]                        [th]Action[/th]                        [th]PC[/th]                        [th]Console (Xbox & Stadia / PlayStation®)[/th]                    [/tr]                                                    [tr]                        [td]Interaction to use Map Utility Items[/td]                        [td]F[/td]                        [td]B / ▢[/td]                    [/tr]                            [/table]     

[h3][b]New Feature: Ascender[/b][/h3]       

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f47437ba8cae8387bf0426f0e096828f494673a8.jpg[/img]

Are you going to climb those towering skyscrapers on foot?
        
Nope! Travel the flashy and fastest way on vertical spaces with the new [b]Ascenders[/b]!Use the Ascenders to create some Mission Impossible moments while getting your hands on some loot at the top!
        [list]            [*]Ascenders are spread throughout the map as ropes attached to objects that allow vertical traversal.[list]                    [*]Both ends of the Ascender are accessible any time.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]With an Ascender, you can swiftly descend from the highest rooftop with no risk of fall damage.[/*]            [*]You can not use an Ascender when another player is currently using the same one.[/*]            [*]You are unable to loot items from the ground when you’re on an Ascender.[/*]            [*]Once mounted on an Ascender:[list]                    [*]You can move up and down the rope using movement keys.  [list]                            [*]Using the Sprint key while [b]moving down (only) [/b]will increase the speed of descent.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]You can dismount from the Ascender at any point.[list]                            [*]If you dismount at the top of the rope, you will teleport to the spot on the building near the top.[/*]                            [*]Otherwise, you will let go and fall.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]You can still be shot and killed on an Ascender.[list]                            [*]You will detach from the Ascender and fall to the ground.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Ropes can be found inside and outside structures.[list]                    [*]Ropes are static objects that don’t have movement.[/*]                    [*]Ropes can be found on varying heights based on the structure.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]
[b]Cell Towers[/b][/*]        [/list]        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2a990356d4ee0e6713b3de4ba5e87d3960329714.jpg[/img]

      [list]            [*]Cell Towers are very tall and thin [b]Ascender-focused buildings[/b]. [/*]            [*]These towers allow you to ride an Ascender from the ground level up to a very high position in one, long ascent.[/*]            [*]Ascending and descending on a Cell Tower provides a faster traveling speed compared to regular Ascenders.[/*]            [*]When you press the Interaction key at the top of the tower, you will be flung into the air in the direction you’re facing.[/*]            [*]Shortly after being flung into the air, your Utility Parachute will automatically deploy, allowing you to safely glide a long distance.[/*]            [*]Ascending a Cell Tower and traveling with your Utility Parachute will help you reach your destination faster than traveling on foot![/*]        [/list]            [table]                                    [tr]                        [th]PlayerState[/th]                        [th]PlayerAction[/th]                        [th]PCKey(s)[/th]                        [th]Console (Xbox & Stadia / PlayStation®)Key(s)[/th]                    [/tr]                                                    [tr]                        [td]Standing/Crouching/Swimming[/td]                        [td]Initiate Ascent/Descent[/td]                        [td]Interaction Key (F)[/td]                        [td]Interaction Key (X / ▢)[/td]                    [/tr]                    [tr]                        [td]While Ascending/Descending[/td]                        [td]Go Up[/td]                        [td]Move Forward (W)[/td]                        [td]Move Forward (Left Stick Up)[/td]                    [/tr]                    [tr]                        [td]While Ascending/Descending[/td]                        [td]Go Down[/td]                        [td]Move Backward (S)[/td]                        [td]Move Backward (Left Stick Down)[/td]                    [/tr]                    [tr]                        [td]While Descending[/td]                        [td]Fast Descent[/td]                        [td]Sprint (Shift)[/td]                        [td]Sprint (L3 / Press Left Stick)[/td]                    [/tr]                    [tr]                        [td]While Ascending/Descending[/td]                        [td]Cancel/Fall Ascent/Descent[/td]                        [td]Interact Button (F)[/td]                        [td]Interaction Key (X / ▢)[/td]                    [/tr]                            [/table]       

[h3][b]Drone Accessible Spaces[/b][/h3]        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2fdf0975cc12eb8bf9054e714a1999cf631df2e6.jpg[/img]

We have also created spaces in Deston that are [b]only accessible by Drones[/b]. We hope to create additional opportunities for Drone use and variety to your looting experience. Are you capable of finding all these spots?
        
[h3][b]New Feature: Security Keys and Security Doors[/b][/h3]      

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d9ad49e3d081f76cb2a598baeca0804ca5e03b6d.jpg[/img]

Discover new ways to roam Deston with the new [b]Security Doors[/b]! Pick up [b]Security Keys[/b], unlock Security Doors, and pick up high-tier items at your own risk.
        [list]            [*]Security Doors are located throughout buildings in Deston.[/*]            [*]Security Keys will…[list]                    [*]World spawn around the map.[/*]                    [*]Stack in your Inventory.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Security Keys are consumable items and will be removed after single use.[/*]            [*]Security Doors can be grouped together so that one Security Key can unlock the entire group.[/*]            [*]Security Doors can not be closed nor relocked.[list]                    [*]Therefore, the open doors will be a hint to other players that you’ve been (or still are) at this area.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Available modes[list]                    [*]Only available in Deston.[/*]                    [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches, Sandbox Mode (PC)[list]                            [*]Unavailable in Custom Match – Esports Mode.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]        

[h3][b]New Feature: Fuel Pump[/b][/h3]       

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/786639678ffeed2c1d7af774b56f45267389b2c0.jpg[/img]

As you and your vehicle chase down an enemy, you realize you’re almost out of gas… when you notice out of the corner of your eye a Fuel Pump!
        
Stop by the [b]Fuel Pump[/b] to refuel your vehicles, or why not make it explode to finish off your enemies?
        [list]            [*]Fuel Pumps will be located throughout Deston.[/*]            [*]Only the driver riding the vehicle can press the Interaction key to refuel the vehicle.[list]                    [*]You are required to press the Interaction key for 1 second.[/*]                    [*]The vehicle much be at a full stop to refuel.[/*]                    [*]The use radius is 5m.[/*]                    [*]If the vehicle moves or the driver changes seats during refuel, the refuel will cancel.[/*]                    [*]The driver can repress the Interaction key to cancel fueling.[/*]                    [*]Vehicles must be missing a minimum amount of fuel before they can use the Fuel Pump.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]There is no limit to using Fuel Pumps.[/*]            [*]Fuel Pumps have a health value.[list]                    [*]They can receive damage and be destroyed, which creates a large explosion and damages all players around it.[/*]                    [*]After receiving damage, Fuel Pumps will spark and begin leaking gas, exploding after a few seconds. Additional damage dealt to the Fuel Pump will cause it to explode sooner.[/*]                    [*]When a Fuel Pump’s health falls below a certain value, it will begin taking damage over time until it completely runs out of health.[/*]                    [*]Destroyed Fuel Pumps can not be used.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Available modes[list]                    [*]Only available in Deston.[/*]                    [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches, Sandbox Mode (PC)[list]                            [*]Unavailable in Custom Match – Esports Mode.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Keys[/b][/*]        [/list]              [table]                                    [tr]                        [th]PlayerState[/th]                        [th]PlayerAction[/th]                        [th]PCKey(s)[/th]                        [th]Console (Xbox & Stadia / PlayStation®)Key(s)[/th]                    [/tr]                                                    [tr]                        [td]Driver[/td]                        [td]Initiate Fueling[/td]                        [td]Interact Button (F)[/td]                        [td]Interaction Button (Hold X / ▢)[/td]                    [/tr]                    [tr]                        [td]Driver[/td]                        [td]Cancel Fueling[/td]                        [td]Interact Button (F)[/td]                        [td]Interaction Button (X / ▢)[/td]                    [/tr]                            [/table]       [h3][b]New Weapon: [/b][b]O12[/b][/h3]        

Introducing the world’s fastest shotgun: [b]O12[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7db1aa94f2590429f7556886dc3a36be959a9d6f.jpg[/img]
        
Not only is the O12 a high-capacity weapon, but the potential lethality of each slug ammo combined with its sheer volume of fire will also make it feared in both close- and mid-range combat! Its relatively long range than any other shotgun will make the O12 a worthwhile choice for every player.
        [list]            [*]The O12 will world spawn in Deston.[/*]            [*]Weapon slot: Primary weapon[/*]            [*]Ammo: 12 Gauge Slug[/*]            [*]Available modes[list]                    [*]Only available in Deston.[/*]                    [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches, Sandbox Mode (PC)[list]                            [*]Unavailable in Custom Match – Esports Mode.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]                  [table]                                    [tr]                        [th]Stat[/th]                        [th]Value[/th]                    [/tr]                                                    [tr]                        [td]Weapon Class[/td] newsitems.title: Community Care Package - June 2022
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0dad3e8254129fd71a8f2fbc6e3d7818cb0e1d6a.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

We're back with another Community Care Package and this time we’re going over some anti-cheat updates following our [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/dev-letter/]last dev letter[/url].

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS has seen a lot of changes over the last few months, including the return of original Sanhok, new weapons, Training Mode improvements, and perhaps most importantly, our transition to being free-to-play. The latter of these changes has also been a cause for concern among the playerbase, with many fearing that the influx of players contrasted by barrier to entry would mean more and more cheaters on the Battlegrounds.

Our Anti-Cheat Team has been fighting cheaters and cheat programs harder than ever since the free-to-play transition. Of course, we were also very aware that players were consistently experiencing unfair and illegal methods in-game.

These concerns are what we’d like to cover in today’s Care Package.

[b]Current Status[/b]
As mentioned in our previous anti-cheat dev letter, we've made steady reinforcements to our proprietary anti-cheat solution "Zakynthos" to deal with cheaters tampering with the vulnerabilities in our client. As a result, we’ve seen no significant change to both Normal and Ranked match metrics as compared to the metrics before our free-to-play transition. In fact, we were able to see some improvements! However, even with these improvements after free-to-play, we know that you expect even more from us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/83e55a36ff6417aad46d8edd7d970e43abef8beb.jpg[/img]

To that end, many other anti-cheat reinforcements are continuously being made and we continue to issue permanent bans to more than 200,000 cheat accounts on a monthly basis since free-to-play.

On top of that, we have upcoming plans on how to improve our anti-cheat methods further.
[h2][b]Upcoming Anti-Cheat Plans[/b][/h2]

[b][list]
[*] Account Hacks
[/list][/b]
A significant number of reported cheaters in Ranked matches were discovered to be hacked accounts (cheaters using other players' accounts).

During the investigation process, we discovered that merely 2% of new accounts who received permanent bans after free-to-play were Plus accounts; approximately 61% were basic accounts; and approximately 33% were accounts created before the free-to-play shift.

Simply put, since basic accounts do not have access to Ranked matches, a majority of accounts reported to be cheating in Ranked were assumed to be created before free-to-play. It is currently difficult to extract the exact numbers, but it is reasonably presumed the major part of reported accounts were not used by the original account owners, but hacked and used to cheat by cheaters.

Therefore, to lessen further damage, we are working on improving our internal logic to recognize hacked accounts. Additionally, we are considering solutions to immediately block accounts suspected to be hacked. We'll share updates once notable achievements are made.

Please remember: Your account belongs to you and you only. Check out our [url=https://support.pubg.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002735674-How-can-I-protect-my-password-]PUBG Support page[/url] to learn how to protect your account from potential hacks and risks.
[b][list]
[*] Penalties on Account Sharing and Creating Multiple Accounts
[/list]
[/b] As stated in the[url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2022/05/13/sharing-account/] Reminder on Sharing Accounts post[/url], the act of account sharing/rental goes against our Terms of Service. These actions lead up to permanent account bans and various penalties to be reinforced moving forward. We have also strengthened our countermeasures against illegal account rental sites that hand out mass numbers of generated accounts (an easy method to use cheat programs) by logging related account sharing tools and issuing penalties based on the extracted information.

Additionally, since free-to-play, we've noticed large quantities of accounts being created on identical hardware within a very short period of time with the accounts' nicknames following a certain pattern. An average of 2,000 accounts are being generated this way on a daily basis. These created accounts are then distributed to cheaters and are used for cheat program promotions, account rental services and various in-game abuse. Our Anti-Cheat Team has begun their initial countermeasures on these cases since April, and their actions will continue to stretch out further.
[b][list]
[*] Improving False Bans
[/list][/b]
The 1 Day Temporary Bans are issued based on players' reports and specific in-game data. We are continuing to sustain this ban system as it has proved to have detected many abnormal activities when we thoroughly examine banned accounts and their use of cheat programs during the temporary banned period. However, it is also true that innocent players receive unnecessary penalties due to inaccurate judgments. To alleviate these issues, our Anti-Cheat Team has implemented a new solution this May. We are consistently monitoring this solution's effects and will continue to update regular improvements to further reduce false bans.
[list]
[*] [b]Zakynthos Reinforcements[/b]
[/list]
Our proprietary anti-cheat solution Zakynthos is developing even at this moment in time through its machine learning techniques to detect cheat programs better and faster. As there is a limit to reactively countering cheat programs (especially unclear ones) through regular monitoring sessions, it is more important than ever to improve technology-wise.
[list]
[*] [b]Making it Difficult for Cheat Developers and Cheaters[/b]
[/list]
Fundamentally, to reduce the number of cheaters, we'd need to create an environment where it's difficult to develop and use cheat programs in the first place. Therefore, the Anti-Cheat Team will further reinforce countermeasures such as permanent account bans and hardware bans and make it hard for cheats that take advantage of in-game vulnerabilities by also adding various defense mechanisms. Our terms and policies will also be reinforced to stomp out the development and use of cheat programs especially in Ranked matches. 

As per usual, we can’t go into detail about many of our tactics, but we do truly wish to share and communicate more frequently with you all, where possible. Sadly, the more in-depth info we give out, the more hints cheat developers and cheaters could pick up, so we continue to be cautious as to what we say.

Just know that every PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS team shares the same goal: to develop and maintain a fair gameplay experience for all. Our Anti-Cheat Team will relentlessly counter cheaters and do our best to have our reinforced solutions reassure players to enjoy a safer and trustworthy game.


Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.title: PNC 2022 Pickem Challenge
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

The PUBG Nations Cup is back and right around the corner! With its return, we’re gearing up for a new Pick’em Challenge!

Starting June 16th, 16 teams from around the world will face off in Bangkok, Thailand to prove their nation is the best PUBG has to offer! Like before, you can cast your votes for participating teams in order to earn Esports Points to exchange for free Esports gear in the shop.

Let’s dive in and learn more!

[b]PUBG ESPORTS TAB[/b]

The PUBG esports tab is back and up running!

Dive into the esports tab to learn general information about the PNC 2022 tournament. You can also click on the button at the bottom left corner to head on to the dedicated PNC 2022 Event Website. There, you can also learn deeper about the PNC 2022 and participate in on-line promotions. Give it a try!


[b]PNC 2022 ITEMS[/b]

[list]
[*]     PNC 2022 All-in-one Bundle   
[*]         PNC 2022 Hotstreak Hat   
[*]         PNC 2022 Hotstreak Jacket   
[*]         PNC 2022 Hotstreak Legs   
[*]         PNC 2022 Hotstreak Boots   
[*]         PNC 2022 Hotstreak - M416   
[*]         PNC 2022 Dance - Champion's Struggle
[*]         + 5 Voting Coupons
[/list]
   
PNC 2022 Tech Vest (Level 2) (EP ITEM)

* 30% of PUBG net sales of PNC 2022 items will be distributed to the teams according to their final results.

** Pick'em Challenge is not available for the Console platform. However, all PNC 2022 items will be available for purchase from the store.
*** The items shown in this post may reappear through other in-game platforms (such as Your Shop, etc.) and/or events and promotions even after their Store sales periods.

PNC 2022 Pick'em Challenge Schedule

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3f7a9645309749f66af47fd8209ca721f9650ec1.png[/img]

The Pick'em Challenge for PUBG Nations Cup starts now! Starting from June 8th you will be able to both purchase PNC 2022 items and cast your picks. No worries for the console players! Pickem items will be also available on console from June 16th to 29th.

PNC 2022 Item Sales Period

[list]
[*]     PC: June 8th ~ June 17th UTC 08:00 (KST 17:00) 
[*]     Console: June 16th ~ June 29th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00) 
[/list]

PNC 2022 Pick'em Challenge Voting Period

[list]
[*] June 8th ~ June 17th UTC 09:00 (KST 18:00) 
[/list]

PNC 2022 Pick'em Reward Claiming Period

[list]
[*] June 21st UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00) ~ June 29th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00)
[/list]

[b]PNC 2022 Pick'em Challenge Details[/b]

PNC 2022 Pick'em Challenge will last only around a week! The window will be very narrow so plan your picks wisely but also fast!

[b]Event: Pick the winner[/b]

Your challenge is simple but won't be that easy. Cast your vote on the team which you think will win the tournament. You can cast max 7 votes out of 16 teams. If your chosen team victors, you will be rewarded with 100,000EP! Earned Esport Points can be spent at the Esports Shop for a reward.

[b]FREE Voting Coupons, EP and more![/b]

Earn free voting coupons and EP by simply watching and interacting during the tournament! 

Free Voting Coupons

Tune into PNC official livesteams for a chance at a special code that grants a free voting coupon!

[list]
[*] The code will only be available on the very first day of PNC 2022, so watch the live broadcast closely and grab your free coupon!
[/list]
One more easy way to earn a voting coupon is to simply visit the in-game event tab.
[list]
[*]     Click the Join Event button
[*]     Complete a couple easy missions
[*]     Earn a voting coupon! Easy!
[/list]

Twitch Drops

Watch PNC 2022 at official PUBG Twitch broadcasts to receive free EP drops during the tournament! 

   [list]
[*]  Viewers must have a KRAFTON ID linked to their platform (e.g. Steam) and Twitch Account to receive EP drops.
[/list]
        [list]
[*] Visit [url=https://accounts.krafton.com/login]https://accounts.krafton.com/login[/url] to create your KRAFTON ID or check and ensure your accounts are successfully linked.
[/list]

[b]Pick & Go[/b]

Participate in Pick & Go Bingo at the official PUBG Esports Twitch channel. Compete with nine other players randomly matched with you from the chat and score the highest points to earn free EP!

[list]
[*]     You earn points every time your selected teams eliminate other players.
[*]         If all teams placed in a straight line earn a point, it's a bingo! Each bingo will grant bonus points.
[*]         If a selected team placed in the center successfully wins a chicken dinner, you'll be granted 1,000 bonus points
[*]         Bonus placement points are also granted for teams placing in the top 8. Pick wisely! 
[*]     A new Pick & Go game starts each match, so play as much as you want to win more!
[/list]

[b]Nations Cup Fantasy League[/b]

New way to earn PNC gear! Visit [url=https://twire.gg/en/pubg]https://twire.gg/en/pubg[/url] to play official PUBG Nations Cup 2022 Fantasy League.

Simply sign into twire.gg to build your own team and earn points as your roster of players compete in PNC 2022! 

Here, you will be able to build your own fantasy team and compete with other players! Can your fantasy team dominate the tournament? 

   [list]
[*]  The Top 10 players in the Fantasy League will be award with G-Coin and a Full PNC Mega Bundle!
[*]     Top ranking player will be awarded with extra goodies & a signed shirt!
[/list]

To learn more about Twire Fantasy League, click on the following LINK

([url=https://twire.gg/en/pubg/news/308/fantasy-league-is-live-for-pubg-nations-cup-2022]https://twire.gg/en/pubg/news/308/fantasy-league-is-live-for-pubg-nations-cup-2022[/url])

newsitems.title: PNC 2022: Update on the Participating Teams
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6dc8df349edd745888f303a93acae2247042b458.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports Fans.

As the return of the PUBG Nations Cup fast approaches, we wanted to inform you of an issue we've run into with one of the teams. As excited as we are to get back into the thrills of an in-person tournament and after exhausting every way to have everyone on-site, Team China will, unfortunately, participate in PNC 2022 remotely.

Over the last couple of years, PUBG Esports have had to adjust quite a bit in the wake of the pandemic. From full-on remote tournaments to hybrid ones, we’ve had to compromise in certain aspects to keep the show running. 

In Shanghai, where most of the PCL PUBG Esports teams are located, teams are facing ongoing pandemic challenges and even had to convert PCL Spring to an online tournament during the middle of the season. While we all hope to get back to some semblance of normal soon, the reality is that we must respect each nation’s local policies.

How did we decide on this exception?

Our goal for PNC 2022 was an on-site event for both players and fans to enjoy. We reviewed every possible method we could think of to achieve this for the grand return of the Nation’s Cup. In the end, the pandemic-related travel restrictions forced us to have to consider online participation over in-person. 

With this inevitability, we’ve put together the following prerequisites for Team China:

[list]
[*]     All members of Team China participating in PNC 2022 must be present in one place.
[*]     An assigned staff and referee must also be present in order to ensure a fair competitive environment.
[*]     The provided PCs and equipment will be identical to that of the Bangkok arena. 
[*]     Team China's online participation should not interfere with or affect the Bangkok arena.
[/list]
The PUBG Esports team has been diligent in finding a location that can accommodate all of the above requirements and has decided that Team China will participate online from Guangzhou city. This is a location close to Bangkok to reduce latency while still having the resources to make the competitive environment as close to the Bangkok arena as possible.

Over 40 test matches were played during an 8-day test period and the average ping in Guangzhou city during that time was 40-60ms as compared to the 20-40ms that players in Bangkok received. With Bangkok's ping maintaining a similar level of ping to our usual esports server, we are confident we’ve done all we can to ensure that latency won’t get in the way of the competition.

The PUBG Esports team has shared this information with Team China and the other 15 national teams in advance, to ensure everyone is in agreement and has all the details. We will continue to monitor the situation and will continue to do our best to ensure that all 16 national teams can perform in an equal and fair environment. It’s our hope to not have to make these exceptions for much longer, but thank you and the teams for your understanding as we continue to adjust in the wake of the pandemic.

PUBG Esports Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ba94de2cf97f41a46ab9bfe947871002eba961e0.jpg[/img]

Today, we're showing off the animation refresh coming soon to PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. We wanted to take the current animations and infuse them with the desperate struggle for survival that PUBG has become known for. The goal is that the intensity and tension that the player feels in every match is also reflected through their avatar. 

We understand that longtime players who are already familiar with the existing character animations and movements might be concerned about adapting to the new ones. However, no timings have been altered during this process, and the weapon handling should feel exactly the same. It's more like a fresh coat of paint on your trusty Dacia. It looks new but handles just like you remember. 

Again, we focused on minimizing the impact on your gameplay. PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS' unique gunplay elements remain the same and animations were only altered to improve accuracy, add intensity and weight, and allow it to be expressed in action.

Take a look at the details below!

[b]FPP Motion Refresh[/b]

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/FPP-Refresh.gif[/img]

[list]
[b]Weapon Animation[/b]
[*] Previously, most of the action when handling or reloading a weapon happened off-screen. Reloading a gun allows players to better see the weapons they have skins for and have been working hard to customize, so we made more parts of it visible on the screen. Furthermore, we changed the character's movements to be more aggressive to make them feel more substantial.

[b]Sprint Locomotion[/b]

[*] As mentioned in the weapon animation, most of the character's actions were happening off-screen when running with a weapon. Now the weapon's position has been raised to make it more visible. In addition, more intensity has been added to the weapon movement, which we think is more satisfying.
[/list]

[b]TPP Motion Refresh[/b]

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/TPP-Refresh-1.gif[/img]

[b]Run and Walk, Start and Stop[/b]

[list]
[*] The previous character movement was generally stable and consistent but without a convincing transfer of weight to speed. In other words, we had room to add some realistic movements, so we added more weight to the character's actions and made them more visible when changing speed.
[/list]
[b]Melee Attacks[/b]

[list]
[*] Prior to the update, the melee attacks had some jitter and were evenly timed. We tried to make it more seamless and natural, and we think this helps make the action look and feel more powerful. 
[/list]
We're always looking for ways we can improve the game without affecting the core feel players have gotten used to, so we hope you're as pleased with these changes as we are. As always, we look forwards to your feedback and we'll see you on the Battlegrounds!


PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

The long-awaited return of the PUBG Nations Cup is near!

newsitems.title: Reminder on Sharing Accounts
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bf0349a592d1a74d50b603a56fec9343dfd6cf9b.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

Have you ever said yes to a "hey can I borrow your account so I can try out your Progressive Weapon Skin?"

Well, you should [i][b]always say no[/b][/i] when it comes to sharing your account information!

We've been receiving many reports on account sharing/rental actions throughout our community; so we're here today to remind you once again of the importance of protecting your account.

The act of lending your account to others - this includes close friends and family members! - violates our [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/tos-website/][b]Terms of Service.[/b][/url] In other words, you may end up receiving harsh penalties (such as permanent bans and/or removal of PUBG Partner status) the moment your account is shared with others.

Posts prompting and/or suggesting account sharing uploaded to official PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS community channels will be taken down without notice; and of course, you'll be receiving penalties if you happen to host/participate in such activities.

You will bear [b]full responsibility[/b] for your account's activities - regardless of the situation, you'll be facing heavy penalties once your account is found to have gone through actions that go against our rules.

The mentioned penalties will not be lifted from your account even if you were unaware of your account activities made by others.

So just remember one thing: never let others use your account!

Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5b47847e9f67e9b9c1662e760b8b808ec8f8ae42.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]17.2 Highlights[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=zPmNxqeXG3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Live Maintenance Schedule[/b][/h2][list]    [*]PC[list]            [*]May 11, specific time to be updated.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PDT: May 18, 9 PM – May 19, 4 AM[/*]            [*]CEST: May 19, 6 AM – 1 PM[/*]            [*]KST: May 19, 1 PM – 8 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issuesㄹ[/b]

[h2][b]Tactical Gear[/b][/h2][h3][b]Spotter Scope[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d49d008422aed91fad7dec3e5f040c2231866836.jpg[/img]

The previous Patch Notes hinted some big and small changes were soon to come to the [b]Spotter Scope[/b]. The Spotter Scope and its automatic features of marking and following enemies continue to show overly strong performance, causing more stress than enjoyable experiences to our players. Therefore, starting from this update, you shall now be able to meet the following, healthier changes:
[list]    [*]The enemy detection range has been changed from 1000m → 600m.[/*]    [*]The white passive marker will NOT appear automatically in ADS mode.[list]            [*]It now requires you to [b]hold [/b]the Fire key to begin scanning for enemies.[/*]            [*]Once a scan begins, a meter will appear on the screen and start to fill up. It will take up a second for the scan meter to fill up completely.[/*]            [*]Exiting ADS mode during a scan will cancel the scanning process altogether and require you to start again from the beginning.[/*]            [*]Once the scan meter is full, passive marker(s) will then appear on enemies within the Spotter Scope’s field of view.[list]                    [*]However, enemies who enter the Spotter Scope’s field of view [b]after [/b]a scan is complete will [b]not [/b]be marked.[/*]                    [*]Passive markers will also appear on enemies hiding within smoke.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]You may initiate and complete as many scans as you’d like in ADS mode.[list]                    [*]A new scan can not begin while a scan is already in progress.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]When you complete a new scan, the previous set of passive markers is overwritten with a new one.[/*]            [*]There is no time limit to the duration of passive markers and they will continue to mark enemies even when enemies hide in smoke or foliage, but passive markers will disappear when marked enemies hide behind solid cover such as trees or buildings, or when they exit the Spotter Scope’s field of view, or if you stop using the Spotter Scope.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]You can also choose to [b]tap [/b]the Fire key instead of holding it to perform a different function – tapping the fire button when passive marked enemies are within your field of view and positioned in the center rectangle of the Spotter Scope will change passive markers to red active markers.[list]            [*]The red active marker now marks enemies individually for 3 seconds.[list]                    [*]After 3 seconds, the active markers will turn back to passive ones if the enemies are still within the Spotter Scope’s field of view. Otherwise, the marks will completely vanish altogether.[/*]                    [*]If you tap the Fire key when you’ve already changed passive markers to active, you can extend the duration of your existing active markers.[/*]                    [*]Active markers will disappear as soon as enemies are out of sight – this includes when they hide behind cover.[/*]                    [*]If you are marked with an active marker by the enemy, you will receive a warning message on your screen.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Even if passive marked enemies are inside smoke, you can convert their passive markers to active ones.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*](Console) The key for normal screen ping has been changed to the following:[list]            [*]Controller A, B Type: RB (Xbox, Stadia) / R1 (PlayStation®)[/*]            [*]Controller C Type: R Stick (Xbox, Stadia) / R3 (PlayStation®)[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2][b]Weapon Balance[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ffdf36e386e8bc8613359c193fd2aeb2b33d417c.jpg[/img]

[h3]5.56mm Designated Marksman Rifles (DMR)[/h3]
According to the stats, the usage rate of the two weapons using 5.56mm was far below our expectations. However, we hope the following minor changes make them more appealing and used more frequently. Moreover, we have changed the position of the Mk12 as a high-end DMR. 
[list]    [*]MK12[list]            [*]Since the damage-related update, players still found it challenging to handle. Therefore, we improved the recoil recovery value to ensure stability like the Mini14[list]                    [*]Increased recoil recovery[/*]                    [*]Re-balanced the recoil related speed[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Mini 14[list]            [*]The Mini14 continues to show steady selection rate due to its distinct traits – therefore, its damage has been slightly improved.[list]                    [*]Damage 47 → 48[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Mortar[/h3]
We’ve constantly listened to your feedback since the Mortar was introduced as a Taego-only weapon. Unfortunately, contrary to our expectations, the Mortar definitely wasn’t one of the most favored weapons. It didn’t take us long to figure out the reason. When deploying it on the surface, it had many limitations, aiming was too complicated, and even the ammo was hard to find. It doesn’t end there; it occupies one main weapon slot, which many players found not to be worth it. However, we are still seeing a lot of feedback about how attractive a weapon the Mortar is. In this iteration of the Mortar, we applied the following changes to unlock its hidden potential.
[list]    [*]It can now be deployed on any terrain, except when the deploy angle is not secured or on water, including small puddles.[list]            [*]Asphalt, Concrete, Iron, Grass, Sand, Snow, Ice, Rock, etc.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Available on Normal matches: Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, Vikendi, Karakin, Paramo, Taego.[list]            [*]Due to its distinct map characteristics, Mortar is not available on Haven.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Now the Mortar takes up the inventory slot and the weight is set to 50.[/*]    [*]It can be picked up and stored in the inventory again after use.[/*]    [*]Picking the Mortar up with a primary weapon in hand will automatically have you swap to the Mortar.[/*]    [*]Picking the Mortar up with bare hands (with two primary weapons holstered) will place the Mortar in the inventory.[/*]    [*]Swapping a primary weapon out with the Mortar in the inventory screen will have you drop the primary weapon.[/*]    [*]Picking up the Mortar when the player is not equipped with any weapons will place the Mortar to the first primary weapon slot.[/*]    [*]Ammo weight is lowered to 20 in lieu of the previous 30[/*]    [*]Ammo spawns in a stack of 3- 5 in lieu of the previous 1 – 3[/*]    [*](Console) UX changes[list]            [*]Put into inventory: A key (Xbox, Stadia) / X key (PlayStation®)[/*]            [*]Unequipping: X key (Xbox, Stadia) / ▢ key (PlayStation®)[/*]            [*]Can not equip to primary weapon slot by looting it from the ground or trunk of a vehicle.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Map Service[/b][/h2]
We are currently preparing a more flexible system for our map services. With that being said, a separate Map Service Plan announcement will not be released as we believe it’s a bit too early to announce our upcoming plans. However, we will continue to announce the map service updates for the current patch through the Patch Notes.
[list]    [*][b]Normal Match[/b]        [list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Sanhok / Haven → [b]Vikendi[/b][/*]            [*]The map rotation for Normal Matches will pluck Haven out and plant Vikendi back in.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Ranked[/b]        [list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2][b]World[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b4c012cab8c5442a7983e713011adcfaedacd556.png[/img]

[h3][b]B.Duck Collaboration[/b][/h3]
Dive into the lake located at the middle island of Sanhok and meet the giant, floating rubber duck bobbing in the calm waters.
[list]    [*]B.Duck is a map decoration – therefore, nothing will happen even if you attack the duck.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Weather[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3fd6e99281c20948d95cbf9f63bb029d67224279.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]The colors of the weather and terrain texture in Miramar have been adjusted to reduce the map’s glaring, yellow shade.[/*]    [*]Adjusted color of certain weathers for Paramo, Haven, and Karakin as well to represent a more realistic atmosphere.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Training Mode[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/97a2f77c6d0ca88561c37e40b2569621de6b61f9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Area: 1v1 Arena[/b][/h3]

Who’s the better player? Find out in the 1v1 Arena.

Additional constructions have been made to Training Mode to welcome all types of combat practice in a suspenseful 1v1 setting. Either go through 1v1 rounds with a real player or spectate intense fights in the new 1v1 Arena.
[list]    [*][b]How to use the 1v1 Arena[/b]        [list]            [*]Interact with the signboards located in front of the ticket booth outside the arena to either participate or spectate.[/*]            [*]Numerous interactable signboards to either sign up for a 1v1 match or to spectate are also scattered around the arena.[/*]            [*]Participants: Will be registered to the 1v1 matching pool[list]                    [*]You may cancel your matchmaking any time by interacting with the ticket booth again.[/*]                    [*]Once matchmaking is complete, a 5 second countdown will pop up before you enter the arena.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Spectators: Will enter the spectator area after a 5 second countdown[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Basic rules of a 1v1 match[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/15666f80443b96acdf7b0d882b783bb26d0f65fc.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]While waiting for your turn to enter a 1v1 match, you will not be able to enter other training areas such as the Aim/Sound Lab, private indoor target practice, or Jump School. Attempting to do so will cause a message to pop up asking if you’d like to cancel your 1v1 matchmaking.[list]            [*]However, you [b]can [/b]enter a 1v1 match while you’re searching for a Ranked match.[list]                    [*]But keep in mind you’ll be forced to quit from a 1v1 match once your Ranked matchmaking is complete.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]You and your opponent will play three rounds.[list]            [*]The player to win the first two will win.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]There is a time limit of 60 seconds per round.[list]            [*]If a player dies within the 60 second time limit, the round will immediately end.[/*]            [*]If both players die at the same time or if no one dies within the time limit, the round will end as a tie.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Once you spawn on the fighting grounds, you can not move nor receive any damage for 3 seconds.[/*]    [*]Your HP will be set to 200.[/*]    [*]You and your opponent will spawn on each side of the arena and switch sides every round.[/*]    [*]The results will turn out as the following [b]if [/b]your opponent quits during a round:[list]            [*]When opponent leaves in the first round, [b]you win.[/b][/*]            [*]When you lose in the first round and the opponent leaves in the second round, it’s a[b] tie.[/b][/*]            [*]When you win in the first round and the opponent leaves in the second round, [b]you win.[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Equipment[list]            [*]Basic equipment: Vest (Lv.3), Helmet (Lv.3), Backpack (Lv.3)[/*]            [*]Weapons: Two primary weapons and one secondary weapon[list]                    [*]The weapons you’re holding before you enter the match.[list]                            [*]You can not change them after entering the arena.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]Other items such as ammo, heal items, and/or Tactical Gear will disappear from your Inventory once you enter the arena.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Ammo: 2 stacks for each held weapon[/*]            [*]If you are not holding any weapons [b]or [/b]if you only have throwables and/or melee weapons in hand, the default weapons will be provided:[list]                    [*]M416 and SKS[/*]                    [*]Pan[/*]                    [*]Grenade[/*]                    [*]Handgun: P18C[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]The state of your ammo and armor will reset each round.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]After a 1v1 match, the results screen will pop up displaying the final results along with the results of each round.[/*][/list]
[b]Spectators [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/822bab17d601750613053c97f5bd183c5817c64c.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]May enter the arena any time even when a 1v1 match is not in progress.[/*]    [*]Players who are up in line for a 1v1 matchmaking may enter as a spectator while waiting for their turn.[/*]    [*]Your screen will display the current situation of a round in progress.[/*]    [*]You will enter the arena with no weapons/equipment in hand.[list]            [*]However, you will have throwable apples.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The use of emotes is available in the spectator area.[/*]    [*]You can not enter the fighting grounds from the spectator area.[/*]    [*]You may interact with interactable signboards within the spectator area if you wish to sign up for a 1v1 match.[/*]    [*]After a 1v1 match, the results screen will pop up displaying the final results along with the results of each round.[/*]    [*]After a 1v1 match, you may continue to wait for the next match to start.[/*]    [*]Spectators may leave the arena any time by pressing:[list]            [*]PC: B key[/*]            [*]Console: D-Pad Left[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h3][b]New Feature: Map Teleportation[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/48e84ef1b88f3c68637f3468f81596fc2d4cb0bf.jpg[/img]

As Training Mode continues to expand with its new features and areas, we’ve decided to add a teleport feature to save time and create a more convenient experience for you all.
[list]    [*]Open up the World Map to teleport within the training grounds.[/*]    [*]Clickable icons are shown on the map. Click on the icon of your choice and you’ll instantly find yourself at your destination.[list]            [*](PC only) You may also use the list of thumbnails of specific areas shown on the left side of the World Map.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]Aim/Sound Lab Score System[/b][/h3]
With the addition of new categories to the Aim/Sound Lab’s scoring system, players who pull off relatively difficult combat stunts will earn extra points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c303a0170b5e0eaeece12d9610aee2007baac803.jpg[/img]

Prepare to dominate the cosmic realm with the new Survivor Pass: Galaxy Squad! For more details, make sure to check out the soon-to-be released May Store Update announcement.

[h2][b]Throwables Timer[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c8444fbc036aaeeeeed01bb80c357c23630805bd.jpg[/img]

Throwables are small but precious weapons that can impact the game when used at the right time. However, throwing a throwable at the right time can be very challenging, even for skilled players, especially during combat situations. 

We are happy to introduce the Throwables Cooking Timer UI to improve the current situation where players are reluctant to use throwables. 

This feature is intended to help the less experienced players to use the throwables in Normal matches so that in the future, they can freely use throwables without the guide UI in Ranked. Also, we are aware of some concerns from the community. Therefore, we will continue to monitor the situation.
