newsitems.title: Road to PGC: PGC Point distribution
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a46c0032e77f8b7e3945480b0688ed1cd5846c41.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

The grand race to the PGC 2022 has finally begun and a number of teams have already cranked their engines to acquire precious PGC points!

Read on to learn more about PGC point distribution for all four regions.

[h1]EUROPE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2740be61d423252626c5e7e27531ccb0d1c06413.png[/img]

EUROPE will have a total of 8 slots at PGC 2022 and teams will be seeded as follows:

[list]
[*] The 7 teams with the highest number of points following the completion of PCS7, excluding the PCS7 winner, will qualify for the PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] The winner of PCS7 will receive a direct invitation to PGC 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each of Europe’s three sub-regions - Europe West, Europe East, and Middle East & Africa - will be guaranteed a place at PGC.
[*] This means that the highest ranking squad from any sub-region that does not have a PGC-qualified team will be awarded the eighth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about EUROPE's PUBG Esports 2022 [url=https://www.pubgesports.com/en/news/1336/view]Click here[/url] 

[h1]AMERICAS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/41fd0c8c470cc708c401f823775972c5d7a9774f.png[/img]

AMERICAS will be seeded with a total of 6 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] The winner of the PCS7 
[*] PGC Point leader from sub-region that doesn’t win PCS7
[*] Top 4 teams in the PGC Qualification Points leaderboard, excluding the teams who have already qualified based on the above.  
[/list]

To learn more about AMERICAS's PUBG Esports 2022, [url=https://na.pubgesports.com/news/pubg-esports-americas-2022-road-to-pgc]Click here [/url]

[h1]ASIA[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e368a62eabd38cf948ba110b23eb2453ce027f7e.png[/img]

ASIA will be seeded with a total of 12 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] Top 12 teams with the highest amount of points will be able to join the year's greatest event, PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each sub-region, Chinese Taipei, Japan, will each have one guaranteed slot within ASIA's 12 PGC slots.
[*] In case the Top 12 does not include all sub-regions, The highest ranking squad from the missing sub-region will be awarded the eleventh and/or twelfth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about ASIA's PUBG Esports 2022, Click here (CN, Chinese Taipei, KR)

[url=https://weibo.com/ttarticle/p/show?id=2309404729903831450323&luicode=20000061&lfid=4729903835252021]CN:[/url]
[url=https://www.pubgesports.com/kr/news/1353/view]TW: [/url]
[url=https://www.pubgesports.com/tpe/news/1354/view]KR: [/url]

[h1]APAC[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ed9bd8d6ebffc67fe2acba5ce64156b860ec2ded.png[/img]

APAC will be seeded with a total of 6 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] Top 5 teams, excluding the PCS7 winner, with the highest amount of points will be able to join the year's greatest event, PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] The winner of the PCS7 will receive direct invitation to the PGC 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each sub-region, Thailand and Vietnam, will each have one guaranteed slot within APAC's 6 PGC slots.
[*] In case the Top 6 does not include all sub-regions, The highest ranking squad from the missing sub-region will be awarded the fifth and/or sixth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about APAC's PUBG Esports 2022, [url=https://asia.battlegrounds.pubg.com/en/2022/02/11/welcome-to-pubg-esports-apac-2022/]Click here [/url]



The grand journey towards this year's PUBG GLOBAL Championship has just started!

Please stay tuned to your regional events just as ESL, GLOOT, PWS and PCL to watch and cheer for your favorite teams as they collect crucial points for the biggest tournament of the year!

We will be back with more information on upcoming PCS6 soon next month!

Until then, we'll see you on the Battlegrounds!


PUBG Esports Team

newsitems.title: LABS: Zombie Survival 2.0 & Discord Event
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a812271a5111f3b6d4ea5cb175ec9204a8a6d673.jpg[/img]


Hello Survivors!

The zombies are back! This time, they’re stronger, smarter, and even more thirsty for blood…

In this second comeback of Zombie Survival, you’ll have to utilize new tactical items and cooperate with your team to outsmart the living dead… or else be doomed!

We also have a Discord event prepared for those brave enough to clear every stage of Zombie Survival 2.0. Read till the end to learn how to receive 30 Contraband Coupons by busting zombies!
[h2][b]Basic Rules[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Zombie Survival has a total of 10 stages that last 3 minutes each.[/*]    [*]To get to the next stage:[list]            [*]Kill every zombie OR[/*]            [*]At least one teammate stays alive until the very end.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Once a stage is cleared, you and your squad will have a 20-second break before moving on to the next stage.[list]            [*]Teammates who died in the previous stage will respawn and continue to the next stage as well.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The game will end as a Zombie Dinner if the entire squad gets wiped out.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/66753199341ccdd40413af8efea5ded1805ac7a8.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Zombies[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Zombies spawn once a stage starts.[/*]    [*]As you proceed along the stages, expect more zombies, stronger zombies, and even special types of zombies![/*]    [*]There are new types of zombies in Zombie Survival 2.0 such as:[list]            [*]Zombies throwing Molotov Cocktails,[/*]            [*]Zombies throwing Blue Zone Grenades,[/*]            [*]Zombies holding grenades in their mouths (can only be killed by headshots),[/*]            [*]And zombies with C4 attached to their bodies.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/12c5338d290358a870acd685d72e5a71cda3e7b0.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Survival Coins and New Items[/b][/h2][list]    [*][b]Survival Coins[/b]        [list]            [*]Earn Survival Coins by taking down zombies.[/*]            [*]The Survival Coins are stored in your inventory (Max. 999).[/*]            [*]Players cannot drop Survival Coins.[/*]            [*]Players who die and respawn for the next stage will have the amount of Survival Coins they had before they died.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Equipment[/b]        [list]            [*]The basic set of equipment each player starts out with is:[list]                    [*]Deagle[/*]                    [*]60EA .45 ACP[/*]                    [*]Backpack (Level 3)[/*]                    [*]1 Grenade[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Purchase various tactical items through your inventory with Survival Coins.[/*]            [*]Stronger weapons cost more Survival Coins.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]New Items[/b]        [list]            [*]There are additional tactical items in Zombie Survival 2.0 such as:[list]                    [*]Traps to temporarily stop zombies from moving,[/*]                    [*]Sticky Traps and Sticky Chemicals to temporarily slow down zombies,[/*]                    [*]Zombie Stun Grenades to stun zombies,[/*]                    [*]Healing Chemicals to heal you and your team,[/*]                    [*]Zombie C4, Can Bombs, Zombie Blue Zone Grenades, Anti-Zombie Chemicals, and Anti-Zombie Table Legs to deal damage.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/abfe6b4372732243183231f9b4f862b0a74d0ebf.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Scores[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Scores are cumulated by taking down zombies.[/*]    [*]Check your current score anytime during the game by pressing the world map.[/*]    [*]You and your teammates’ final scores will be shown after the game.[/*][/list][h2][b]Service Schedule[/b][/h2]
Zombie Survival 2.0 will run during the following period:
[list]    [*]PC[list]            [*]PST: February 15, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 27, 2022, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 16, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 28, 2022, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 16, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 28, 2022, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PST: February 23, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 6, 2022, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 24, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 7, 2022, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 24, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 7, 2022, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay Settings[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Only Supports TPP[/*]    [*]4-Man Squad Only[/*]    [*]DBNO Disabled[/*]    [*]Teamkill Disabled[/*][/list][h2][b]Notes When Playing in LABS[/b][/h2][list]    [*]LABS games do not provide XP or gameplay rewards.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on the Career page.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on Match History.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay does not support replay.[/*]    [*]Zombie kills will not count towards BATTLESTAT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Discord Event[/b][/h2]
Want to take down zombies [u]and [/u]get rewards? Clear every stage of Zombie Survival 2.0, upload your Chicken Dinner screenshot (shown below) to your region’s Zombie Survival Discord channel, and receive [b]30 Contraband Coupons[/b]!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5654d137997bf3261c7152dba2a3848b2987f313.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to Participate[/h3][olist]    [*]Clear all 10 stages of Zombie Survival 2.0 during the event period.[/*]    [*]Take a screenshot of your Chicken Dinner screen (you must take your own!).[/*]    [*]Enter your region’s Discord server.[/*]    [*]Enter the [b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Event Submission Channel.[/b][/*]    [*]Upload your [b]Chicken Dinner screenshot[/b] to the channel along with your [b]PUBG Nickname[/b] and [b]game platform[/b] you’re playing on(Steam / PlayStation® / Xbox / Stadia / etc.).[/*]    [*]You’re done![/*][/olist][h3]Discord Channels[/h3]
The Zombie Survival channel where you can submit your Chicken Dinner screenshot will open on [b]the day the event starts[/b].
[list]    [*]Global: [url=https://discord.com/invite/battlegrounds]https://discord.com/invite/battlegrounds[/url]
[/*]    [*]Russia: [url=https://discord.com/invite/pubgru]https://discord.com/invite/pubgru[/url][/*]    [*]Turkey: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgturkiye]https://discord.gg/pubgturkiye[/url][/*]    [*]Middle East and North Africa: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgmena]https://discord.gg/pubgmena[/url][/*]    [*]Brazil: [url=https://discord.com/invite/pubg-brasil]https://discord.com/invite/pubg-brasil[/url][/*]    [*]Latin America: [url=https://discord.gg/pubglatam]https://discord.gg/pubglatam[/url][/*]    [*]Vietnam: [url=https://discord.gg/x879qxmQYy]https://discord.gg/x879qxmQYy[/url][/*]    [*]Indonesia: [url=https://discord.gg/u2qmNePqev]https://discord.gg/u2qmNePqev[/url][/*]    [*]Taiwan: [url=https://discord.gg/xhCwSRTR2u]https://discord.gg/xhCwSRTR2u[/url][/*]    [*]Japan: [url=https://discord.gg/VcjqdjU]https://discord.gg/VcjqdjU[/url][/*]    [*]Korea: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgkorea]https://discord.gg/pubgkorea[/url][/*][/list]
[b]Event Reward[/b]
[list]    [*]Contraband Coupon x30[/*][/list]
[b]Event Period[/b]
[list]    [*]PC & Console[list]            [*]PST: February 17, 2022, 4 PM – February 21, 2022, 3:59 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 18, 2022, 1 AM – February 22, 2022, 12:59 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 18, 2022, 9 AM – February 22, 2022, 8:59 AM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Important Notes[/h3][list]    [*]This event will be hosted on Discord only.[/*]    [*]Players may participate in this event only once per account.[list]            [*]Even if you submit multiple submissions, they will only be counted as one.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Only players who participate within the event period will be able to receive the reward.[list]            [*]The [b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Event Submission Channel[/b] will be disabled once the event ends.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]You must clear all 10 stages of Zombie Survival 2.0 to be able to receive the reward.[/*]    [*]Your Discord username and PUBG nickname do not have to be identical.[/*]    [*]Every teammate must capture and upload their own Chicken Dinner screenshot to receive the reward.[list]            [*][b]Your PUBG nickname must be highlighted[/b] to be counted.[/*]            [*]You will not be able to receive the reward if you use other players’ screenshots.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The reward will be automatically granted to your account at the latest by March 4, 2022, 11 AM UTC.[/*][/list]
Good luck, don’t get bitten, and remember to have fun.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.title: Patch Notes - Update 16.1
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3c857c910b51ee21ac14d327273caeae59c1a309.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Note: Moving forward, our monthly Patch Notes will contain both PC and Console updates in a single announcement (thus the simple title).
[h3][b]16.1 Highlights[/b][/h3]
To be updated with the Live Server update.

[b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b]
[h3][b]Weapon Balance[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bed536e10354256095ce2b54eeaded4375fb959b.jpg[/img]

We’re back with another weapon balance in this update to provide each weapon type a chance to shine in tactical battles and to prevent scenarios where players are all holstering the identical, overperforming weapon.

After we toned down M416’s reload time, base damage, initial bullet speed, and damage drop-off range in Update 7.2 due to the M416 being the most powerful AR and one of the top performing guns in the whole game, we noticed our players were gradually dropping the M416 for stronger ARs such as the Beryl M762. However, despite Beryl M762’s several nerfs in past updates, the weapon continues to show strong in-game performance. Additionally, out of all the DMRs, we’ve noticed the SLR was being favored due to its powerful damage – therefore, players’ options in battles seemed to be narrowed down to the Beryl M762 and the SLR.

Yet, we didn’t want to stress our players out more by nerfing well-used weapons, so instead we’ve decided to not only bring M416’s stats back up, but we also buffed the hard-hitting, high-velocity Mk12 while having it spawn in other maps to prompt more frequent 5.56mm ammo usage among DMRs.

※ Damage drop-off range: The distance at which the weapon’s damage starts to decrease from its maximum damage percentage.
[h3]M416[/h3][list]    [*]Damage increase: 40 → 41[/*]    [*]Initial bullet speed increase: 780m/s → 880m/s[/*]    [*]Damage drop-off range increased: 50m → 60m[/*][/list][h3]Mk12[/h3][list]    [*]Damage increase: 50 → 51[/*]    [*]Damage drop-off range increased: 75m → 90m[/*]    [*]The Mk12 will now spawn in every available map (Normal and Ranked).[list]            [*]The spawn settings in Custom Matches have been applied accordingly.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/21eb41a0b6babbcf338d4faf15ff7a9e9e786834.jpg[/img]

[h3]SMGs and Shotguns[/h3]
We heard and are aware of our players’ thoughts on our past weapon balancing on SMGs, Shotguns, etc., but the reason as to why it is difficult to actively readjust in-game balancing is due to the requirement of using several months of cumulative data as a foundation to potential changes. Therefore, we will continue tracking our players’ feedback and data to bring healthier balances to the game.

newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/41fb60d05638e993bd3e844090f0c7621c10dc71.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors,

Back in Update 15.1, we applied a number of changes to our map service plan based on the feedback you provided. We also promised that we’d announce our future plans once they were ready to go and today we’re happy to introduce our plan for the first quarter of 2022.

[h3][b]Map Service Plan[/b][/h3]
(Like most things, the content of this plan may be subject to change!)

※ The plan below applies to both PC and Console.
[h3][b]Normal Matches[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Update 16.1[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Sanhok / Karakin[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Update 16.2[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Karakin / Haven[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Update 17.1[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Haven / Sanhok[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
During our preparation for Update 15.1’s map rotation, we were still running tests on Haven, such as making sure bots were working properly. We ended up needing more time than expected to complete these tasks, so Haven was eventually pulled from the rotation. With those tests now complete, players will soon be able to dive back into Haven’s 1×1 urban mayhem!

We also noticed lots of questions around missing maps while they’re off rotation. This is understandable since every player’s map preference is obviously different. Still, we’ve decided to update the map rotation every monthly update, starting with Update 16.1, so players won’t have to be without their favorite map for a whole Season. 

And last but not least, Sanhok will be taking a break in Update 16.2 while it undergoes several massive changes. Stay tuned for more details on Sanhok’s big update in future Patch Notes.
[h3][b]Ranked Mode[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*][/list]
The three 8x8km maps shown above will continue to be permanent fixtures for Ranked.

After Update 17.1, a revised Map Service Plan will be revealed in a separate announcement, once we’ve decided on the future map rotation and general direction of map services for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. As always, your feedback is a great reference while we are making decisions and we encourage you to always keep those thoughts and suggestions coming! 

Thanks, and we’ll see you on the Battlegrounds!

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.title: PC & Console Patch Notes - Update 15.2
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/eb906336f4acebbcee90632f798b339e089dc7e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Free to Play Transition [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e4c13700b332263b591f780176aea84b8e651525.png[/img]

Hello, Survivors. PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS has advanced through various platforms to share its unique Battle Royale experience with a broader audience. Now with our free-to-play transition, we want to further expand our community, provide faster matchmaking, and the opportunity to meet more opponents. After the transition free-to-play, BATTLEGROUNDS Plus account is added and all players who have owned and played PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS before the free-to-play service transition will automatically receive the PUBG – SPECIAL COMMEMORATIVE PACK.

We look forward to sharing our unique Battle Royale experience with more survivors. For details on the free play service transition, please check the [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p/]Free-to-Play Announcement[/url].

[h2][b]Live Maintenance Schedule [/b][/h2]
Please note that the maintenance time may take longer than usual, as we will be updating each platform’s store and distributing rewards to our existing players. The Test Server will close along with the Live Server Maintenance. Due to the transition to free-to-play, the 15.2 Live Server will go under  maintenance at the same time on both PC and Console. 
[list]    [*]Free-to-play Service Transition: After the live server maintenance on January 12, 2022.[/*]    [*]Server Maintenance Schedule[list]            [*]PST: January 10, 2022 10 AM – Until maintenance end on January 12, 2022 (TBD)[/*]            [*]CET: January 10, 2022 7 PM – Until maintenance end on January 12, 2022[/*]            [*]KST: January 11, 2022 3 AM – Until maintenance end on January 12, 2022[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]15.2 Highlights[/b][/h2]
To be updated with the Live Server update.

[b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b]

[h1][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Feature: Tactical Gear [/b][/h2]

We’ve decided to introduce a whole new category of tactical items, Tactical Gear, that strays from pure gunplay to provide our players various options for improving their in-game performances.

As Tactical Gear will be taking up players’ primary weapon slots, we hope this will allow players to come up with more creative long-term strategies.

[b]Tactical Gear: Drone[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/53a1efe146178e0dddaf4a24a927311bc390ff1f.jpg[/img]

The Drone is a Tactical Gear that allows players to scout a far distance safely and even pick up an item without facing the risk of direct combat.

[list]    [*]Drones will spawn in every map.[/*]    [*]Drones will be available in Normal Matches, Custom Games, Training Mode, and Sandbox Mode.[/*]    [*]Once players loot and equip the drone, they can hold the Drone Tablet in their hands.[/*]    [*]Players can then toggle in and out of Drone View.[list]            [*]The Drone will launch into the air once players toggle into Drone View.[/*]            [*]A Drone in flight will make noise and have a distinctive blinking light.[/*]            [*]A deployed Drone will be identifiable by a unique drone icon both on the map and minimap.[/*]            [*]In Drone View, players’ characters will stop moving and give up control of their body as they fly around in the perspective of the Drone.[/*]            [*]If players toggle out of Drone View, the Drone will remain hovering in its current position.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players can recall a Drone in flight.[list]            [*]When a recall is initiated, the Drone will attempt to fly back in a straight line to the spot the player recalled it.[/*]            [*]The Drone will fly back to the location the player first recalled it.[/*]            [*]When the recall is in progress, the recall will be stopped if the player attempts to use the Drone Tablet.[/*]            [*]When the recall is in progress, the recall will be stopped if the player uses the recall feature again.[/*]            [*]The Drone can not avoid obstacles or move through solid objects while being recalled.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The Drone has a large 300m operation radius that players must stay in while flying the Drone.[list]            [*]The Drone alerts players with a warning message and a static screen when it’s within 90m of its maximum operation radius.[/*]            [*]If the Drone leaves its operation radius, it will get destroyed and players will need to retrieve it and repair the Drone to use it again.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The Drone has a maximum HP of 35 and can take damage from various things.[list]            [*]A Drone can be damaged by[list]                    [*]Gunfire[/*]                    [*]Explosions[/*]                    [*]Fire[/*]                    [*]Water[/*]                    [*]Flying outside of the operation radius[/*]                    [*]Vehicle collision[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]When the Drone’s HP reaches 0, it will fall to the ground and get destroyed. Players must retrieve the Drone and repair it to use it again.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]A Drone can loot a single item to its single inventory slot.[list]            [*]For example, a stack of bandages (5) is also considered a single item.[/*]            [*]Drones can not pick up items from Care Packages, deathboxes, and trunks.[/*]            [*]Players in Drone View are also able to drop the held item any time.[/*]            [*]Players can receive the Drone’s held item by recalling the Drone.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players will be able to ping normally while toggled in Drone View.[list]            [*]The ping icon will be displayed as a regular ping.[/*]        [/list]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1150e8fce8e53d7cc1127880bcd05c7b8ac84c85.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/60be855331c8a4d85517d7a86cdb64c921d7959a.jpg[/img]

[b]Tactical Gear: EMT Gear[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/397ac4c2a76b2315c5bed208b834118c15d794fc.jpg[/img]

The EMT Gear is a Tactical Gear that allows players to opt into increased healing potential for both themselves and their team at the cost of reduced combat flexibility.

[list]    [*]The EMT Gear will spawn in every map.[list]            [*]2 stacks of bandages (10) will spawn alongside the EMT Gear.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The EMT Gear will be available in Normal Matches, Custom Games, Training Mode, and Sandbox Mode.[/*]    [*]Players will receive numerous passive benefits with the EMT Gear, regardless of if they’re holding it or have it stowed away.[list]            [*]It will only take 3 seconds to use healing items such as bandages, First Aid Kits, and Med Kits.[/*]            [*]It will only take 3 seconds to revive a knocked down teammate.[/*]            [*]Players can walk much faster when using healing items than when normally using healing items.[/*]            [*]Bandages and First Aid Kits can heal players to max health.[/*]            [*]Med Kits will give full boost to players.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players with the EMT Gear equipped will gain an ability to interact with damaged teammates.[list]            [*]Players can spend one of their own healing items on their teammate. [/*]            [*]Players can toggle between different healing items on the bottom screen where a weapon’s fire mode would normally be displayed.[list]                    [*]The display would also show the number of the selected heal item that the player has in their inventory.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The EMT Gear will NOT grant the following boosts when used in the Blue Zone:[list]            [*]Healing boosts (teammates can still be healed)[/*]            [*]Shortened revival time[/*]        [/list]    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54b8c3d8f7d44d7c8c9406f9c80ae498045020bf.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]New Mode: Tutorials [/b][/h2]

To create a richer gameplay experience for not only new players but also for returning players, we are adding two in-game tutorial modes that provide a step-by-step process. As for returning players who haven’t accessed our game for months, these tutorials will help you revive your rusty battle skills before you’re ready to plunge back into action.

[h3]Tutorial 1: Basic Training Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0282c5c59b30d91432e035864de804895d4b8f63.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Players will go through five stages in this mode:[list]            [*]Basic character movements[/*]            [*]Looting and shooting guns[/*]            [*]Looting and throwing throwables[/*]            [*]Using healing items[/*]            [*]Reviving knocked down teammate[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]New and returning players must complete this mode first to proceed to the next AI Training Match tutorial.[/*]    [*]Current players who feel the need to practice are also free to access this mode in the Training tab.[/*][/list]

[h3]Tutorial 2: AI Training Match[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/20cff4bdb0cdb680c2edc4a5e63ee16bd8fdc4af.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Players will be facing 99 bots in this mock game mode to grasp the flow of how an actual normal match would look and feel like.[/*]    [*]Map: Erangel[/*]    [*]Only supports TPP.[/*]    [*]During each situation and phase, messages will pop up in the upper left corner of the screen to guide players on what to do.[/*]    [*]Players can complete this mode by satisfying one of the following conditions:[list]            [*]Play 10 AI Training Matches (Players must play longer than a certain time each match to be counted.)[/*]            [*]Complete every mission[list]                    [*]Players can find the mission list in the game mode selection screen and/or in the System Menu.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Current players may also play up to 10 AI Training Matches per account.[list]            [*]Since PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS provides the fun of coming up with strategies to use against real enemies in a battle royale setting, we believe the 10 match limit in AI Training Matches is just enough for players who need the practice.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]New and returning players who complete this mode before playing all 10 matches will still be able to play the remaining matches left.[/*]    [*]AI Training Matches will NOT affect/provide:[list]            [*]Career (Stats/Match History/Medals/Survival/Weapons/Replays)[/*]            [*]Pass Missions[/*]            [*]Event Missions[/*]            [*]Battlestat[/*]            [*]BP Rewards[/*]            [*]XP Rewards[/*]            [*]Custom Match[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
New and returning players will not be able to play other game modes before they complete the tutorials. (However, you’ll be able to play normal matches if you’re in a party.)

[h3]Lobby Tutorial Missions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8e9ccde12a46eea0314d529d32ce674f941548ff.jpg[/img]

 [*]We have prepared extra missions to help players get used to our game once they are done with the two tutorials.[/*]    [*]Players can check the Events page to see their mission lists and each mission’s progress.[/*]    [*]All missions will be automatically accepted.[/*]    [*]Players who complete the missions will be able to receive various rewards.[list]            [*]Once players receive every reward, the mission list will disappear.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Lobby tutorial missions and their rewards are only provided once per account.[/*][/list]

[h3]Training Mode [/h3]

We’ve made some big improvements to our current Training Mode based on our community’s feedback to create a more effective and efficient space for players wanting to hone their skills.

[h3]Training Helper[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fb31670f4142f470414ef189381fe30aa47a6592.jpg[/img]

In the current Training Mode, we noticed that players had to roam about finding and looting needed weapons, ammo, and attachments. Furthermore, in order to practice using several guns, players had to stay near the gun spawning area to conveniently switch weapons.

Therefore, we would like to introduce the new Training Helper! With this feature, players will be able to whip up any weapon or item any time, anywhere.
[list]    [*]To bring up the Training Helper, press:[list]            [*]PC: ‘,’ (comma) key[/*]            [*]PlayStation®: Touchpad button hold[/*]            [*]Xbox: View button hold[/*]            [*]Stadia: Google Assistant button hold[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The maximum number of items a player can summon is 200.[list]            [*]Each item summon will be counted as 1.[list]                    [*]For example, even if a player summons 30 rounds of ammo, it will be counted as 1 summon.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Vehicles and specific throwables can not be summoned.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players will now be able to adjust sensitivity with the Training Helper right away without having to go in Settings every time.[/*][/list]

[h3]Practice Range[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6c3ca0343aef57f7eed17b0669023a4078284d68.jpg[/img]

As we observed players practicing their aiming and shooting on the walls, we decided to implement a proper system where players could practice all they want without any interference.

Therefore, a private indoor target practice area has been built into Training Mode.
[list]    [*]Players can enter this private area through the indoor range door.[/*]    [*]Even if multiple players enter simultaneously, players will end up arriving at their own training domain alone – like magic.[/*]    [*]Once inside, players can use the buttons in front of the shooting target to adjust the target’s distance or to reset its state.[/*]    [*]Two monitors will be available on the left for further assistance: the lower monitor will display a close-up of your shots while the upper monitor will present your scores.[list]            [*]The left side of the scores is the number of bullets that hit the target; the right side is the percentage of your bullets landing within the target’s circle.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The score will not calculate the shots that miss the target.[/*][/list]

[h3]Shooting Target Improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1d05f60e11d97a2239adcd7ab0fccce17f53caea.jpg[/img]

We’ve modified and improved the shooting targets scattered around Training Mode.
[list]    [*]We’ve added moving targets.[list]            [*]The speed and moving direction are set to random.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]We’ve also added pop-up targets to the Practice Range.[list]            [*]Out of a total of 18 targets, 2 random targets are raised.[/*]            [*]Once the player successfully hits one target, another random target will pop up.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h3]Background Noise Reduction[/h3]

To reduce the inconvenience players feel when getting distracted by other players’ noises, a noise reduction feature has been implemented.

[list]    [*]This feature will reduce the noise of other players such as gun shots, movements, vehicles, and more.[/*]    [*]This feature is enabled automatically and players will not be able to turn it off.[/*]    [*]This feature will not reduce [u]every [/u]background noise as we have set our priority to reducing the main noises that bother other players. However, we will continue to improve this feature.[/*][/list]
[h3]Adding Mortars[/h3]
Mortars and their ammo have been added to Training Mode.

[h2][b]Action Queuing[/b][/h2]

With the Action Queue feature, players can queue up their next desired action by pressing and holding the button while a certain action is in progress. The action will immediately perform after the action in progress ends. For example, if you hold the firing key while reloading, the gun fires immediately after the reload action ends. We already have various action queues applied, but we want to respond to a long-requested community feedback by applying them to more cases to improve the flexibility and responsiveness of game controls.
[list]    [*]Action Queuing is added to shooting, inventory navigating, various moving actions and etc. [/*]    [*]The action bound to the key held will activate after queuing.[/*]    [*]This feature is turned off as default. Please turn on from the Settings.[list]            [*]Go to Settings – Game Play – Functionalities to turn on/off the feature.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h2]Win94 & VSS Improvements [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ea2132e86a7f15c60576d62ab07a7dc3dc5cbc79.jpg[/img]

We wanted to allow fans of the Win94 to use the Iron Sight again, especially for very close combat where a scope is less ideal.
[list]    [*]Players can switch between the scopes and iron sights with the help of a functional flip sight.[/*]    [*]The Win94 will continue to have no sight attachment slot as the Iron Sight is attached by default.[/*][/list]

[b]VSS[/b]


The VSShad a ~3.5X Scope, and this was the only available sight to fire the weapon in ADS with no sight attachments allowed. It has the potential to be useful on short range, however it can be a bit awkward to fight ADS in close quarters with the Scope. We hope this update allows players to fight more easily in close quarters.
[list]    [*]Now you can attach a Canted Sight on the VSS.[/*][/list][h2][b]World [/b][/h2]
[b]PGC feature removal[/b]

We hope to see you all in the next PGC!
[list]    [*]Switched the lobby theme.[/*]    [*]Removed the digital display and graffiti.[/*]    [*]Removed the plane banner.[/*]    [*]Removed the 2021 PGC loading screen.[/*]    [*]Removed the live stream screens.[/*][/list]
[b]KAKAO FRIENDS and Christmas theme removal[/b]

We previously planned to provide “Christmas Weather” only during the collaboration with KAKAO FRIENDS. But, due to the request from the community, we decided to keep it with a slightly lower probability. 
[list]    [*]Removed KAKAO FRIENDS Collaboration-theme.[/*]    [*]Replaced the current digital display image with the default image.[/*]    [*]Brought back the previous Vikendi minimap.[/*]    [*]Removed the Christmas theme.[/*][/list][h2][b]DBNO Balance [/b][/h2]
Have you ever been in that awkward situation where you got killed shortly after entering DBNO by being attacked? It gets frustrating when you’ve just looted all the things you need but soon die, especially in the early stages of the match. This DBNO adjustment focuses on decreasing the amount of annoying DBNO executions which may ruin the game experience. 
[list]    [*]Extended entering the DBNO time.[list]            [*]Lengthen the ‘going into DBNO’ animation time which would increase the invulnerability time from 1 to 1.5 seconds.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Tweaked the DBNO bleed out time.[list]            [*]1st knock: 83 seconds → 90 seconds[/*]            [*]2nd knock: 25 seconds → 30 seconds[/*]            [*]3rd knock: 13 seconds → 30 seconds[/*]            [*]4th knock: 9 seconds → 10 seconds[/*]            [*]5th knock: 7 seconds → 7 seconds(no changes)[/*]            [*]6th knock: 5 seconds(new)[/*]            [*]7th knock: 4 seconds(new)[/*]            [*]8th knock: 3 seconds(new)[/*]            [*]9th knock: 2 seconds(new)[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Increased DBNO movement by 10%.[list]            [*]Movement speed while DBNO underwater remains the same. [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Reduced the Frag Grenade damage when in DBNO by 20%.[/*]    [*]DThe damage received while wearing level 3 armor is now applied in all conditions, including when not wearing anything.[/*]    [*]SR guns and crossbows, including Win94, are not affected by the DBNO balance, and damage has been increased.[list]            [*]SR: 35% increase[/*]            [*]Crossbow: 12.5% increase[/*]            [*]SR and Crossbows apply damage by armor conditions.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]There are no changes in damage received from weapons not mentioned above.[/*][/list][h2][b]QoL[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Screen Ping Marker[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f5c40ae1e3f5dbd4e5e6b3173d9b66ce24bb6214.jpg[/img]

We’ve improved the existing ping system and added the ability to display the ping on the screen where the player can see. We expect this will enable faster and more clear communication between squad mates.
[list]    [*]Available in all Solo, Duo and Squad Modes.[/*]    [*]Not available in Ranked and Esports Modes.[/*][/list]
[b]How to place a screen/map ping marker[/b]
[list]    [*]Point your crosshair where you want to ping and click the mouse wheel, click on the world map or press the insert button.[list]            [*]Xbox/Stadia: R Stick[/*]            [*]PlayStation: R3[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ping markers are distinguishable by the following three categories.[list]            [*]Vehicles[/*]            [*]Location[/*]            [*]Everything else[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Hows to remove Screen, Map Pick Markers[/b]
[list]    [*]One player can place one Ping Marker at a time.[/*]    [*]Previous Ping Marker is removed when placing a new Ping Marker.[/*]    [*]Previous Ping Marker is removed when creating a tactical marker.[/*]    [*]Press the Delete key to remove both Screen and Map Ping Markers at the same time. [list]            [*]When you remove pings with the Delete button after placing them with Radio Message, the Radio Message will remain.[/*]            [*]This feature is not supported on Consoles.  [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h3]Minimap Improvements[/h3]
We have improved the quality of the minimap so that the terrain is displayed more intuitively.
[list]    [*]We have applied the same quality of curves in the map to the mini-map. In addition, the bridges are displayed in the same way as the roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/406b434667af86acead7078df64c86f9b1d76d0c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54593ce847cdb3a30236a4c2092c7f639b8c40e3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f0cb01b2acb174905ad397bf6307afbad88f4203.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b1e923e34cfc012590ebe26a78d6294bdf027a3c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/92a85385b13ec125e49f1bddf0d98da51b9b18b7.jpg[/img]

[/*][/list]
[h2][b]——————[/b][/h2][h1][b]Lobby Updates[/b][/h1][h2][b]UI/UX 2.0 [/b][/h2]
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS’ entire out-game appearance has nicely groomed itself to transform into a fresh new look for all current, returning, and new players. With this huge UI/UX update, players will find both in-game and lobby interfaces to be more accessible, convenient, and complete.

[h3]Lobby Interface Improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/154a30974e4cf139701cecf12a1d5519e4b279e5.jpg[/img]

Our main lobby had maintained its interface since the good old Early Access days… therefore, we have tucked the current destructive, dystopian atmosphere away and applied dark green and sandy colors, dense and subtle dotted textures to express a more modern theme.
[list]    [*]Lobby Menu[list]            [*]The navigation bar has been moved from the left to the very center to minimize players’ movements when moving between the menus and tabs.[/*]            [*]The area for fixed menus and irregular menus (such as Esports) have been divided up.[/*]            [*]The currency area (G-COIN, BP, etc.) have been banished from the navigation bar as they couldn’t coexist with the lobby menus.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Matchmaking Settings[list]            [*]Players will no longer have to waste time opening up a pop-up just to change the game mode. They can now select game modes in the lobby.[/*]            [*]However, players will still be able to change game modes through the current pop-up system – when they do, details on the selected map will now be available as well.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]News Page/Patch Notes Area[/*]    [*][b](news page/patch notes area image)[/b] [list]            [*]The upper right corner of the lobby has a new popover feature that shows News previews.[/*]            [*]Numerous layouts have been applied so they could shift accordingly to fit and show the increasing amount of new community and events news.[/*]            [*]A button that directs players to social channels or community sites has been added.[/*]            [*]Players can now read the Patch Notes in the lobby.[list]                    [*]As for console players, they will be directed to the Patch Notes on the official website.[/*]                    [*]Multiple languages have been added to specific languages.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

In addition to the changes stated above, players will be able to discover updates we’ve made to other out-game elements such as the Notification Center, Store, Create Your Character screen, the Hideout, the Setting Menu for consoles, etc. and other in-game elements as well such as the Settings, Report User window, in-game messages, and so much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/beda563a813e18765ce639cded7226685ef551db.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Store [/b][/h2][list]    [*]Indication of the number of new items in each category on the left side of ITEMS for five days. [list]            [*]Notification marker does not go away even after checking out the new item.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The icon displayed in the set item slot has been improved so that it displays the same as the actual icon of the component.[/*]    [*]Item slot will change colors when there is less than a week left and then highlighted when there is less than 24 hours of time left before the sale ends. [/*][/list]



[h2][b]Continue reading![/b][/h2]

Due to exceeding word limitations, please continue reading here: 

[url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/patch-notes/update-15-2]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/patch-notes/update-15-2[/url]

newsitems.title: A Fond Farewell to 2021
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
Hello Survivors,

As the days tick down towards 2022, we want to take a quick moment to thank you for an amazing and productive year.

2021 saw many changes to the Battlegrounds, including the following:

[list]
[*] We released Taego, a brand new 8×8 Battleground with a Korean theme.
[*] Introduced new LABS modes, including the return of Fantasy Battle Royale and Zombie Mode.
[*] Hosted several global events and tournaments, giving out millions in cash prizes.
[*] Added several new weapons, vehicles, utility items, etc to diversify your drops.
[/list]

And so much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ccfa0c91f85e04601dd752ed5f123a470fd46fce.jpg[/img]

But the New Year is a time to look forward. As you may have seen, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is going [b][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p/]Free-to-play on January 12th[/url][/b]! Now anybody can experience the thrills and chaos of the Battlegrounds alongside our dedicated, longtime fans. So squad up, make your new year’s resolution to eat more chicken with your pals, and start the new year off with a bang!

Thank you as always for your continued love and support and we’ll see you on the Battlegrounds in 2022!

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.title: PUBG Esports 2022
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6789ef06a8504987143ea549de87a3311436a2f4.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans.

2021 started off with a bang, with the first LAN since the pandemic - the PGI.S, Two PUBG Continental Series, and the PUBG Global Championship 2021.

Overall, a total of 90 teams from all over the globe challenged for the road to the championship, and a total of $15,000,000 worth of prize money has been granted, including $7,000,000 dollars contributed by the fans via crowdfunding.

The crowned champion of PGC 2021 will be awarded not only with a total of $1.4 million prize money, honor of the world's best PUBG esports team, but also a special championship skin to commemorate the victory.

PUBG Esports will continue to develop in the upcoming 2022 with global teams and players in order to provide PUBG Esports' unique entertainment.

[b]2022 PUBG ESPORTS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4c0002f61df6ebb39aafe4c255f1b58a59b6d4b2.png[/img]

Building on 2021, PUBG Esports plans to host a total of four global tournaments in 2022.

[b]PUBG Continental Series[/b]

PCS will be back again in 2022! 

2022 will feature PCS6 in April and PCS7 in September.  Just like in 2020 & 2021, each region will host their own online regional championship with PGC points on the line. 

[b]Return of PUBG Nations Cup[/b]

After a two year hiatus, players will be playing for national bragging rights as PUBG Nations Cup will make its return in June.  This unique format has proven to be a favorite (both for fans and us!) and has created some of the most thrilling moments in PUBG Esports history.  We’ll be back to you all soon with more details.

[b]PGC and 2022 Champions![/b]

We’ll cap off 2022 just like we did in 2021 - crowning the best PUBG team in the world at the PUBG Global Championship!  Will this year's winner repeat as Champions or will a new team come out of the woodwork to take the title!  

[b]Regional Third Party[/b]

Regional teams will continue to develop their ecosystems with third party and grassroots events throughout the year.

[b]Thank you![/b]

As we approach another year of PUBG Esports, we need to say a special thank you to all our fans who have supported us throughout another tough year of the global pandemic. 

Look out for information on the regional schedules and even more details on the global events early next year.


Have a safe holiday!

PUBG Esports team

How has 2021 been for you? For us, this year has been a blast with all the Special Drops events we have gone through. We had the Ground Zero watching, ‘Sonny’ Heung-Min Son Item Event that gained massive attention. The Special Drops Summer Season and Rabbits on the Moon along with the Contraband Coupon Event also generated a great amount of love from all you survivors. 

You might think we’ll all be away for the end-of-year season and get lazy with events? No way, that’s not us. You better watch out ’cause we’re telling you why. [h2][b]Partner Drops[/b][/h2]

newsitems.title: 2021 Anti-Cheat Dev Letter
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[*] [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p/(opens in a new tab)][b]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Transition to F2P Service[/b][/url]
[*][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p-events/][b]Pre-registration event[/b][/url][/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/631eb1326cc1290d7e31ad42da70d10d37866b2e.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

As you’ve no doubt heard by now, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is going free-to-play on January 12, 2022! While this is certainly an exciting time, we know that there are often important questions that pop up with such a transition. Namely, how will we address cheaters in a free-to-play game?

Anti-cheat is always a critical priority, but with Free-to-Play incoming, the need for an effective anti-cheat system is more important than ever as banned accounts can easily and infinitely be replaced.

To that end, we've been quietly, yet fiercely, preparing a number of countermeasures to combat cheat programs. That said, anti-cheat is always a never-ending fight and nothing we or anyone can do will ever completely stomp out cheating in competitive online games..

In this Dev Letter, we’re going to dive in and talk more about what we've been building in 2021, how our anti-cheat situation is looking today, and what we have in store for the future.

[h2][b]What We've Been Doing in 2021[/b]
[/h2]
We’ve broken down our 2021 efforts into four categories that we’ll go into more depth on:

[olist]
[*]     Anti-Cheat Solution Improvements
[*]     Hardware Ban Improvements
[*]     Game Client Vulnerabilities
[*]     In-Game Abuse Reinforcements
[/olist]
[b]Anti-Cheat Solution Improvements: Zakynthos[/b]

Zakynthos is our proprietary anti-cheat solution that we implemented in January of 2021 as a means to speed up the anti-cheat process. Where before we had to rely on slower external solutions, the time saved with Zakynthos helped us remove an additional 28% of cheaters from the previous year.

Before we talk about what the future holds for Zakynthos and anti-cheat, let’s take a moment to talk about how we go about tackling cheat programs. When we discover a new cheat program, we secure and reverse engineer said program to get a full, deep analysis of what it does and how it bypasses our security. Once our tests lead us to a countermeasure, we develop detection logic into our anti-cheat solutions. Stability tests and other steps then help to ensure these updates don't compromise the overall integrity of the game.

Even with all of the above, cheat developers are tenacious and will learn how to bypass our anti-cheat solutions' radars after a time, meaning we always need to be adjusting and improving those solutions in an effort to keep up. Here’s a bit of what we will be implementing in 2022:

[list]
[*]     Automatic analysis of cheat software based on machine learning techniques
[*]     24-hour monitoring of Ranked matches in upper ranks
[*]     Implementation of kernel drivers
[*]     Preventing tampering of client
[*]     Hardware ban system improvements
[/list]

[b]Hardware Ban Improvements: Keeping Cheaters Out[/b]

Collecting cheaters' hardware information and dishing out hardware bans has been something we've been doing for some time now. While it is quite effective, every software has its flaws and some dedicated cheaters were able to find ways to circumvent such sanctions on their hardware.

There is also the never-ending struggle of issuing swift and decisive bans while avoiding any false-positives that an operation of this scale is sure to stumble upon.

To help solve these issues, we’ve developed a new hardware ban technology that utilizes special algorithms, which we implemented into Zakynthos. This upgrade eventually resulted in  a near 30% decrease in metrics that track players experiencing and reporting cheaters. The new hardware ban also prevented penalized players from circumventing their bans, which subsequently helped us hold the line in terms of anti-cheat metrics.

[b]Game Client Vulnerabilities[/b]

In 2021, we also focused on dealing with cheats that took advantage of vulnerabilities in our client.

First, to counter speed hacks and flying cars, we made changes so that speed and air time for character and vehicle movement were cross-checked by the server. However, for gameplay aspects where responsiveness is key, having the server cross-check everything could result in sluggish character movement and vehicle control for everyone.

Therefore, we analyzed the play patterns of cheaters, and we were able to apply server-side cross-checks and other defense mechanisms to select accounts only. As a result, the number of players using cheat programs related to character and vehicle movement was reduced by an astounding 99.97%!

Next, we worked on countering cheats that allow players to score kills from absurd distances or that automatically set your crosshair on opponents (or Aimbots, as most would call them). As these types of cheats are especially detrimental to players' willingness to continue playing, we worked very closely with content development teams to add various validations and defense mechanisms regarding weapon firing, as well as reinforcing Zakynthos to better prevent cheaters from tampering with our client.

[b]In-Game Abuse Reinforcements[/b]

As more and more accounts were banned due to our increased anti-cheat efforts, cheaters looked more and more towards acquiring replacement accounts. As demand for Ranked-ready accounts increased, cases of accounts earning Survival Mastery XP in abnormal ways became more prevalent as well.

Also, in high-tier Ranked, we've seen an unfortunate increase in players who constantly team with cheaters to get an unfair advantage towards gaining their RP (Rank Points).

Fighting off cheat programs is very important, but we feel that enforcing these abuse cases are also important in providing a fair gameplay environment. By implementing machine-learning techniques and analyzing abuse cases, we've been doubling down on penalizing players engaging in malicious behavior.

As a result of our efforts, the number of players gaining Survival Mastery XP in abnormal ways has decreased by approximately 30%, and the number of players gaining RP through wrongful methods in high-tier Ranked has decreased by approximately 50%. As improvements are made and players learn they can no longer get away with cheating, these numbers continue to decrease.

[h2][b]Current Anti-Cheat Status
[/b][/h2]
Here on the anti-cheat team, we refer to various metrics to assess the game’s overall anti-cheat status. We first take a look at how many suspected cheater accounts there are out of our monthly player count, as this metric gives an intuitive sense of our overall anti-cheat status.

By delivering on the anti-cheat goals we had for this year, the ratio for suspected cheater accounts has gone down by approximately 45% compared to early 2021, and the situation is continually improving. Our work on patching up client vulnerabilities has continually dropped the average kill count per session for cheaters, a clear sign that the effect cheaters have on our service is decreasing.

Even when comparing the number of permanent bans with last year's, the number has gone down by approximately 47%. Judging by the fact that the ratio of suspected cheaters to monthly traffic has decreased and is staying at similar levels, we can see this as a sign that the number of cheat program users has significantly decreased as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ff1fb0359941f7aa0ae08971f118e9f41aaecb51.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/08e42114975ac2dc74a7c0e8302fa1229ce14f78.png[/img]

[b]Anti-Cheat Analysis During Free Play Week[/b]

Previously, we ran two Free Play Week events - one in 2020 and one in 2021. While great marketing for the game, these weekends also gave us valuable insight into our anti-cheat capabilities in a Free-to-Play environment.

During our June 2020 Free Play Week event, the ratio of suspected cheaters skyrocketed, especially when looking at Normal Matches. However, during the August 2021 Free Play Week event, the ratio of suspected cheaters spiked after the event started but eventually recovered and settled in line with the numbers we had before the event, marking another promising victory for Zakytnthos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7bb3143d034754e06b2375aca5de4de5f1d57ee5.png[/img]
[b]Cheater Reports in Ranked Matches
[/b]
As reports from players in the upper ranks who claimed to have encountered more and more cheaters came in, our team studied the report rate data for each Rank Points range. The graph below shows that the report rate was relatively high early this year, but it gradually fell as we reinforced our anti-cheat solutions over the months. We do realize that not every rate has greatly improved, but it is a promising start and we are planning to strengthen our anti-cheat solutions even further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/21f8e128f20820c4b1156439a6c0d88720144218.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Upcoming Plans for the Anti-Cheat Team
[/b][/h2]
Now that we’ve talked about what we’ve done up until this point, let’s take a look forward at what our teams will be doing for free-to-play and beyond.

We are continuously preparing new and improved anti-cheat reinforcements. To share a few, we are actively looking into improving the situations of cheaters bypassing the SMS authentication system and of cheaters hacking into innocent players' accounts.

We have received numerous suggestions from you all on ways to alleviate cheating in ranked play, including raising the Survival Mastery entry level for Ranked. We have of course considered this suggestion, but are still cautious of the risks of creating a difficult environment for beginners and current players trying to reach the entry bar for Ranked, especially going into free-to-play and its potential for a large influx of new players. We will of course keep a close eye on this and other suggestions as we work towards the ultimate solution.

Cheating is not the only annoyance players face in the game. The spam and promotion of these cheats have continued to be a problem as well. The cheat software promotions happening in-game are being continuously monitored and gradually improved, but we will continue to reinforce our efforts against illegal promotions happening. We will also continue to actively enforce legal measures against those developing, supplying, and selling cheat software.

Console platforms will also see their anti-cheat solutions strengthened. We took measures against lag switches in early December and are continuing to research and develop solutions for cheaters' use of unauthorized controller accessories that also negatively affect gameplay on console platforms.

In addition, we are continuously working on our solutions for other commonly reported cheat software such as ESP (showing enemies' locations) and "Aimbots."

As much as we wish to share more in-depth information with you all, cheat developers are always watching our every move and using every bit of our information to create stronger cheat software and stay a step ahead of our solutions. Therefore, we tried our best to share as much relevant and promising information as we could, while keeping the rest a bit more incognito.

We know you watch our anti-cheat efforts with great interest and know that you’ll continue to hold us to a higher standard due to the sheer competitiveness of a game like BATTLEGROUNDS. We may still be cautious about sharing topics about anti-cheat, but we will always look for ways to communicate what we can more frequently with you. A certain date can't be promised, but we will come back with more news once notable anti-cheat achievements are made.

The battle with cheaters continues as PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS enters the free-to-play world, but we are dedicated and doing all we can to ensure that you not only hear about, but feel the effects of our anti-cheat solutions for yourselves.

Thank you.

See you on the Battlegrounds.

PUBG Anti-Cheat Team

newsitems.title: Free-to-Play Announcement
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Announcements on PUBG F2P service transition[/h3]   

[*][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p-events/][b]2021 Anti-Cheat Dev Letter:[/b][/url][/*]    [*][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p-events/][b]Pre-Registration Event[/b][/url][/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5e00c3d176e90f0a3d152dd1e5742129a239cd5d.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Over the years, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS has seen many changes since it debuted on Steam Early Access. In a humbling turn of events, fans around the world embraced our version of Battle Royale as they experienced the game’s tension, realistic gunplay, and edge of your seat action.

Following this unprecedented success, BATTLEGROUNDS found its way to multiple other platforms, expanding to console and mobile players alike. But now, it’s time for BATTLEGROUNDS to make its biggest leap of all; Free to Play. BATTLEGROUNDS Free-to-play now gives us the opportunity to expand our community even more and bring all the thrills of the game to everyone, while providing new friends, faster matchmaking, and let’s be honest, more targets for our existing player base.

BATTLEGROUNDS Free-to-play will also include a number of improvements we’ve been working on, which fans will see roll out on launch and in the months to follow. Now is truly the best time to play, so check out the details below, get ready to bolster your squad, drop in, and share that Chicken Dinner with as many friends as you can!

[previewyoutube=ak2S07fFhdk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]BATTLEGROUNDS Plus[/b][/h2]

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS will be free for everyone to play! Players will start off with a Basic account, which allows access to most of the game’s features. However, please note that certain features will be limited to BATTLEGROUNDS Plus accounts. 

BATTLEGROUNDS Plus is a new product that gives PUBG fans a way to supplement their BATTLEGROUNDS experience while supporting the game. [u]Plus[/u] is a one-time purchase and includes all of the following:
[list]    [*]BATTLEGROUNDS Plus upgrade product/DLC will be sold for $12.99 USD after the free-to-play transition.[/*]    [*]BATTLEGROUNDS Plus unlocks access to the following:[list]            [*]Survival Mastery XP +100% boost[/*]            [*]Career – Medal tab[/*]            [*]Ranked Mode[/*]            [*]Creating Custom Matches.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]BATTLEGROUNDS Plus includes the following items:[list]            [*]Captain’s Camo Hat[/*]            [*]Captain’s Camo Mask[/*]            [*]Captain’s Camo Gloves[/*]            [*]Bonus 1300 G-COIN[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2596eb135b2ad9e7f5dfb1440784bbb62fbc8c22.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rewards & Benefits: Existing Players[/b][/h2]
It wouldn’t have been possible for us to come all this way without all our Survivors who have supported our game over the years. To show how much we appreciate the support, all players who have owned and played PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS before the free-to-play service transition will automatically receive the PUBG – SPECIAL COMMEMORATIVE PACK, which includes a free BATTLEGROUNDS Plus upgrade and various rewards. These will automatically apply to your account after the free-to-play service conversion.  The conditions for obtaining rewards and the method of receiving them may differ for each platform, so please check out the details below.

[b]What are you going to do about cheating and hacking?[/b]
[list]    [*]There are some differences between Basic and BATTLEGROUNDS Plus in accessible game modes. This is partly aimed at giving additional benefits to those upgrading to the BATTLEGROUNDS Plus, but the ultimate reason for restricting the use of some major content is to prevent cheaters. In the case of Ranked Mode, fair play is required the most as it is a fierce competition of players competing over Rank Points(RP). If anyone can play in a Ranked match without any restrictions, there are concerns about the possibility of an increase in potential cheaters as well as the possibility of banned players returning to the game easily. In addition, in order to prevent actions such as promoting unauthorized programs through creating custom matches, some contents are only available through BATTLEGROUNDS Plus. Anti-cheat is more important than ever as PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is now free-to-play. [list]    [*]We have a few surprises in store for later! Check out the details on our future Patch Notes. [/*][/list]
[b]What’s next for the game[/b]?
[list]    [*]Right now, all of our team’s focus is on the free-to-play service transition. However, we will continue introducing game content that many players will find exciting and fun, as we have always done. For example, the codename “[url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/11/10/map-service-plan/]Kiki[/url]” unfortunately has been postponed to around mid-2022. In addition, as introduced in the Update 14.2 Patch Notes, the next Survivor Pass will be available to you around March 2022. For more details, watch out for future announcements. So please look forward to more to come![/*][/list]
[b]I want to get a refund for the title I purchased. What should I do?[/b]
[list]    [*]Refunds of BATTLEGROUNDS Plus or PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS are made based on the consumer protection law of each region and policies of each platform, so please reach out to each platform company for more detailed inquiries.[/*][/list]
[b]PlayStation® – Japan account players have different conditions to acquire the “PUBG – SPECIAL COMMEMORATIVE PACK.” What are the requirements?[/b]
[list]    [*]For PlayStation® – Japan accounts, we are unable to provide free products of a specific value due to local laws and platform policies. Therefore, please purchase the “PUBG – SPECIAL COMMEMORATIVE PACK” for ¥100 from the PlayStation® Store to obtain the reward.[/*][/list]
See you on the battlegrounds.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team.

Hello Survivors!
