newsitems.title: PC Patch Notes - Update 15.1
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Updates for Live Server[/b][/h2]            
To be updated after the Live server maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5b76eeb429801076344611d7b93101c464b9ea27.jpg[/img]     

[h2][b]15.1 Highlights[/b][/h2]            
            
Starting from this update, our Patch Reports will now be released with the Live server update instead of the Test server update. 

When shooting our amazing Patch Report videos a stable game build is required - however, the build we need becomes complete around the time when the Live server gets updated. 
Due to this hectic process, our creators inevitably undergo crunch mode. Therefore, we decided it would be best for both ourselves and our players to extend our working days and provide a better Patch Report by releasing it on a later date. We appreciate your understanding.
            
[i][b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b] [/i]
            
[h2][b]Map Service Update [/b][/h2]            
We announced the long-term [b][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/11/10/map-service-plan/]Map Service Plan[/url][/b] to our players not so long ago, but after reviewing our players' feedback, we realized our plan was not something our players looked forward to. Therefore, after thorough internal debates based on our community's feedback, we have decided it would be best to change the map rotation service for Season 15 to the following:
            [list]                [*]Normal Match                    [list]                        [*]Erangel / Miramar / Sanhok / Taego / Vikendi[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]                [*]Ranked                    [list]                        [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            Taego will remain in the map rotation for Season 15 due to two reasons: first, our players' feedback, and second, our data showing us that Taego maintains its status as a very popular map. With these being the case, including Haven to the rotation would eventually cause stability issues as we'd have to adapt the map selection UI for regions with map selection without thorough testing. As for regions without map selection, players could feel frustrated having to play several matches before reaching the map they'd like.
            
Please note that our map service plan for Season 16 and later are still being discussed, but a separate announcement will be made to our players once decisions are made.
            
[h2][b]New Vehicle: Mountain Bike [/b][/h2]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/753b90027c0e1c4431bea4990b49938f786876a4.jpg[/img]
            
Attention all triathletes! The Mountain Bike, a fan-requested vehicle is coming to the Battlegrounds. Unlike our other vehicles, the Mountain Bike can be found as a lootable item in its folded state. It can be located most often on the outskirts of the map, helping you have additional transportation methods.
            
Due to the lack of an engine, it hardly makes any noise, allowing for stealthy movement. Combined with Driver shooting, this can lead to some great surprises for your enemies.
            
[b]Specifications[/b]            [list]                [*]Maps: All maps in normal matches[/*]                [*]Spawned in a folded form.[/*]                [*]Unfold it into a rideable vehicle or store them in inventory.[/*]                [*]Folds back into an item when stored back into the inventory.[/*]                [*]Due to the absence of a speedometer, the current traveling speed is not displayed.[/*]                [*]Does not spawn in Esports Mode.[/*]                [*]Maximum number of passengers: One[/*]                [*]Maximum speed:[list]                        [*]Max speed without sprinting (85% Throttle): 50 km/h[/*]                        [*]Riding with 40% or more Boost (90% Throttle): 54 km/h[/*]                        [*]Riding with sprint tapping (100% Throttle): 62 km/h[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]                [*]HP: Cannot be destroyed, including the wheels[/*]                [*]Item weight: 70[/*]                [*]Fuel consumption: None[/*]            [/list]            [b]Sprinting[/b]            
Like in real life, you can sprint on the Mountain Bike by putting in some physical effort to mash the "Move Forward" key repeatedly to cycle faster. Being boosted makes it easier to reach max sprint speed. Higher tapping speeds increase sprint speed.
            
[b]Jumping[/b]            
Additionally, you can put your BMX skills to the test by jumping with the Mountain Bike. Holding the "jump" key longer (up to half a second) will increase jump height. High speed and being boosted also increases the jump height.
            
[b]Wheelies[/b]            
We hipsters don't ride on two wheels. We don't find the need to use all wheels because it just ain't cool! One, that's right, one wheel is all we need. Try to find the perfect balance by holding the "sprint" key and tapping "jump" in rhythm to find the hipster inside you.

[h2][b]Weapon Balance Update  [/b][/h2]            

[b]Weapon Balance[/b]            
As a battle royale game where every match presents different situations, we believe each weapon category should have its purpose in certain types of encounters. Based on our data findings and community feedback we have made weapon balance changes.
            
[b]P90[/b]
            [list]                [*]The P90 is making the most kills of any Crate weapon and is performing better on ranges where we want Crate ARs to dominate. So we decided to increase the recoil difficulty while supplying less ammo.[list]                        [*]                            
Increased horizontal and vertical recoil
                        [/*]                        [*]                            
Increased ADS deviation during full-auto burst
                        [/*]                        [*]                            
Lowered Care package ammo from 250 -> 200 bullets
                        [/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]Shotguns[/b]
            [list]                [*]The Shotguns in Battlegrounds continue to have a very limited role as seen in our data, to improve their usability we are increasing the effective range.[list]                        [*]                            
Increased damage drop-off range to improve effective range by several meters per shotgun
                        [/*]                        [*]                            
Increased hit probability on short range
                        [/*]                        [*]                            
Increased Sawed-Off damage by 1
                        [/*]                        [*]Decreased Sawed-Off pellet spread[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]LMGs[/b]
            [list]                [*]LMGs in general are not considered useful enough based on our data, so we are slightly increasing their damage potential to improve the weapon's role. For MG3 we saw very little usage in our data compared to the other crate weapons so we are making it more powerful.[list]                        [*]Reduced recoil when shooting in crouch and stand[/*]                        [*]Increased Body Damage multiplier from 1.0 to 1.05[/*]                        [*]Increased M249 damage by 1[/*]                        [*]Increased MG3 damage by 2[/*]                        [*]Decreased MG3 horizontal recoil[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]SMGs[/b]
            [list]                [*]While some players feel that SMGs have a strong position due to their relatively low recoil, we still see in data that their role in weapon balance is very limited. To incentivize more accurate firing we are increasing the Head Damage multiplier. [list]                        [*]Increased Head Damage multiplier from 1.8 to 2.1[/*]                        [*]Increased PP-19 Bizon weapon accuracy during ADS full auto firing[/*]                        [*]Decreased UMP45 Damage at longer ranges[/*]                        [*]Decreased UMP45 weapon accuracy during ADS full auto firing[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]AUG[/b]
            [list]                [*]The AUG seems to be overtaken by the P90 and even by the user's ability to control the Beryl, thus we are making it slightly more powerful to improve its Crate weapon status.[list]                        [*]Increased damage by 1[/*]                        [*]Increased damage drop-off range to improve effective range[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]Magazine Balance[/b]            
Based on our data over the years, we see that magazines in PUBG have not been very equally balanced. The Extended QuickDraw magazine offers an obvious upgrade over the Extended and QuickDraw magazines. The QuickDraw magazine is often left aside with players not even bothering to pick them up despite their advantage over having no magazine attachment at all.
            
We have tweaked our magazine attachments to add tactical decision-making and to improve the usefulness of the QuickDraw Magazine and Extended Magazine. Now every magazine attachment will be useful and offer its own play-style.
            
If you want to have up to 60% faster reloads, take a QuickDraw Magazine. If you want to have the highest magazine capacity, take an Extended Magazine. If you want to have a bit of both, take an Extended QuickDraw Magazine.
            
Example when applied to M416:
            [list]                [*]Default Magazine: 30 bullets[/*]                [*]QuickDraw Magazine: 30 bullets and 60% faster reload[/*]                [*]Extended Magazine: 42 bullets[/*]                [*]Extended QuickDraw Magazine: 40 bullets and 15% faster reload[/*]            [/list]            Additionally, we have added the QuickDraw Magazine Attachment to the Skorpion.

            [h2][b]World Updates [/b][/h2]            Sanhok Update            [list]                [*]Bootcamp[/*]            [/list]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/669021883cd08633707993824aef0edeae87ac33.jpg[/img]
[list]                        [*]As being one of the most hottest drop zones in Sanhok, Bootcamp should be able to provide dynamic gameplay experiences. But we've been hearing that our players were not enjoying the reworked Bootcamp as the structure felt too crowded and complex for desirable tactical plays. Therefore, we decided to make Bootcamp undergo another big change and the best way to go at it was to shift the whole structure. Here are some of the main changes:[list]                                [*]To reduce the complexity and bunched-up feeling of Bootcamp, the central tower has been repositioned from the center to the right. We have then considered different angles and distances and adjusted the layout of the other buildings around the center area to provide an open space for better shooting.[/*]                                [*]Players seemed to have too much of an advantage behind the parapet walls on the third floor of the central tower so we got rid of them and instead placed boxes made of stone on the rooftops.                                    [list]                                        [*]We also narrowed the space between the second and third floor to reduce the advantage players had on the third floor.[/*]                                    [/list]                                                              [*]We realized that the large windows on the second floor of the central tower were allowing a wide view of players' surroundings which resulted in frequent camping. Thus, we have shrunk the size of the windows.[/*]                                [*]Training areas have been added and scattered around the center as well to provide more cover and looting spots.[/*]                                [*]We moved the watchtowers to place one each in the north and south to prevent players from hoarding them.[/*]                                [*]Players didn't seem to have the best opportunities when they land a little late on Bootcamp. Therefore, we removed the 4 warehouses within Bootcamp and added 3 to the North (outside of Bootcamp) so even players who start late could earn a better chance at arming and hiding.[/*]                            [/list]                        [/*]                    [/list]                            [*]Shoreline[/*]                       
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5438ea7bdaf2e5551fb0b871a4f7aa69bfe49fb9.jpg[/img]
            [list]                                [*]Players seemed to be feeling vulnerable around the shoreline areas so more rocks and trees have been added.[/*]                                  [*]Weather                    [list]                        [*]The lighting and weather effects in Sanhok seemed to be hindering our players' in-game sight, so we:[list]                                [*]Increased brightness by 25% for Clouds and Sunset weather.[/*]                                [*]Decreased darkness from 66% → 33% when it turns Foggy/Rain during Overcast weather.[/*]                            [/list]                        [/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            [b]Vikendi Update  [/b]         [list]                [*]KAKAO FRIENDS[/*]            [/list]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/aefd9594b6dce2929a849ce0e5c95a6b6104fd36.jpg[/img]
            [list]                                    [*]PUBG's new collaboration is with KAKAO FRIENDS! More information on this collaboration will be updated in a separate announcement on the day the Live Server gets updated.[/*]                        [*]Dinoland has transformed into KAKAO FRIENDS LAND.[list]                                [*]KAKAO FRIENDS statues have been positioned here and there in KAKAO FRIENDS LAND.[/*]                                         [*]Billboards for KAKAO FRIENDS have been added.[/*]                        [*]Buildings have been decorated with KAKAO FRIENDS ornaments.[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]                [*]Christmas[/*]            [/list]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7b571ad0c402226742ef4a1dcc5b7c8835f5d651.jpg[/img]
                              [list]                        [*]Christmas theme has been applied to Dinoland, Castle, and Winery.[/*]                        [*]Christmas weather has been added.[list]                                [*]Players can use this weather setting in Custom Matches for Vikendi.[/*]                            [/list]                        [/*]                    [/list]                         [h2][b]Ranked Season 15 [/b][/h2]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/56d1f23c7f289ef0c3d72c9f6eda1d9962ed8f42.jpg[/img]
            [b]Season 14 Ranked Mode Rewards[/b]            
Season 14 has now wrapped up and it’s time to enjoy your rewards, after a hard-fought season of Ranked. Rewards will be automatically distributed to your inventory upon login at the beginning of Season 15.
            
Season 14 rewards are granted based on your final end-of-season rank.

[b]Unlocked Rewards[/b]            [list]                [*]The[b] [/b]Parachute Skin is a permanent reward players keep forever and can equip as they please.[/*]                [*]The rest of the earnable rewards are only 'Unlocked' for the duration of a single Ranked Season.[/*]                [*]Only the unlocked rewards from a player's highest rank will be granted.[/*]                [*]Unlocked Rewards can be found in the inventory at the start of the new Season.[/*]                [*]Once the Ranked Season is over and the server maintenance begins, Unlocked Rewards will be collected from the inventory.[/*]            [/list]            [h2][b]Training Mode Update  [/b][/h2]            [list]                [*]Every vehicle but the Scooter has been removed from Training Mode to prevent various sound and crash issues and to prevent players from getting bothered by other players' vehicles during shooting practice.[/*]                [*]After we observe the change in memory usage issues, we will discuss about the feature of allowing players to choose a vehicle of their choice in Training Mode.[/*]            [/list]            
[h2][b]Action Wheel Update  [/b][/h2]            
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a972fa6b02a84c800f7ddb19bb803adfe4e320b1.jpg[/img]
            [list]                [*]An additional Action Wheel with 8 more slots has been added as we noticed that players did not seem to have enough space to fit and use all their spray and emote items.[/*]                [*]Players will be able to find their additional Action Wheel in the Customize tab.[/*]                [*]In the lobby or in a match, players can use their mouse wheel to switch between the first and second action wheel.[/*]                [*]If players select spray items from their Action Wheel in the lobby, a message will pop up saying that sprays are unable to use.[/*]            [/list]            [h2][b]Performance Update  [/b][/h2]            [list]                [*]There has been performance updates with the Hideout tab.[list]                        [*]The loading speed when first accessing the page has been improved.[/*]                        [*]A feature that could help prevent accidental weapon upgrades has been added.[list]                                [*]A message showing the current level has been added to the Upgrade button.[/*]                                [*]Once a player clicks the Upgrade button, an additional confirmation message will pop up.[/*]                            [/list]                        [/*]                    [/list]                [/*]                [*]Memory usage has been improved by removing unused and duplicate data files within the game.[/*]            [/list]            [h2][b]Smoke Grenade Sound Update  [/b][/h2]            
Smoke grenade deployment sound and visual effects are now synchronized
            [list]                [*]The deploy sound stops ten seconds before the smoke cover fully disappears.[/*]                [*]Smoke cover fadeout starts when sound effect is stopped, so player can start being visible from five seconds while inside smoke.[/*]            [/list]            [h2][b]Known Issues [/b][/h2]            [list]                [*]New Vehicle: Mountain Bike's tool tip is displayed only in English in all languages.[/*]            [/list]                      [h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[*]Fixed the issue of the PGC 2021 Contingent Chaos - Beryl M762's rail blocking players' sight in ADS mode.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of a player unable to join the Comeback BR after getting killed while disconnected from the game.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of custom game sessions getting deleted due to unknown reasons.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of a dirt the issue of the awkward P90 magazine appearance in the inventory.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of the killfeed text being cut off due to specific killfeed limit settings.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of the Porter's inventory text looking awkward in a specific resolution.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of the text being cut off after a teammate dies in Ranked when player sets game language to English.[/*]            [/list]            [b]Items & Skins[/b]            [list]                [*]Fixed the clipping issue when a male character equips Shadowstar's Top with Moon Rabbit Jacket.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of the Bunny Aeronautics - M416 and Bunny Aeronautics - Mini-14 looking severely dark indoors.[/*]                [*]Fixed the issue of the Night Hunter Costume's bullet loops looking awkward in-game.[/*]                [*]Fixed the clipping issue when the PUBG Varsity Jacket is equipped with most glove items.[/*]                [*]Fixed newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/de8b93febdffeb2fc6f4569cbb70651c700f7449.png[/img]
Hello Survivors,

Today, we're announcing our upcoming, long-term map rotation service for PUBG: Battlegrounds.

[h1]Map Service Plan[/h1]

[h3][b]Normal Mode[/b][/h3]
[b]Fixed Maps[/b]: Erangel / Miramar / Sanhok

[b]Rotation Maps[/b]
    [table]                    [tr]                [th]                    Season                [/th]                [th]                    Large                [/th]                [th]                    Small                [/th]            [/tr]                            [tr]                [td]                    
14
                [/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Paramo[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]15[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Haven[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]16[/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Karakin[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]17[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Paramo[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]18[/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Haven[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]19[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Karakin[/td]            [/tr]            [/table]

[h3][b]Ranked Mode[/b][/h3]
[b]Fixed Maps[/b]: Erangel / Miramar

[b]Rotation Maps[/b]
    [table]                    [tr]                [th]                    Season                [/th]                [th]                    Large                [/th]                [th]                    Small                [/th]            [/tr]                            [tr]                [td]                    
14
                [/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Paramo[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]15[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Sanhok[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]16[/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Karakin[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]17[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Paramo[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]18[/td]                [td]Taego[/td]                [td]Sanhok[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]19[/td]                [td]Vikendi[/td]                [td]Karakin[/td]            [/tr]            [/table]
(The content of this plan may be subject to change according to development and service conditions.)
※ The plan above applies to both PC and Console platforms.

Starting with Season 14, Erangel, Miramar, and Sanhok will be permanent fixtures to the 5-map Normal Mode map rotation. The remaining two map slots will be filled by a small and large map, with the specific maps changing each season.

We know decisions like this always come with questions, so we’ve prepared an FAQ that includes details on changes to help the matchmaking system better facilitate regional needs for future seasons.

[h2][b]FAQ[/b]
[/h2][b]I don't see Codename: Kiki on the rotation plan![/b]
Codename: Kiki's release has unfortunately been delayed to mid-2022 as our development plans have recently shifted towards another big project that is coming very soon (no, it's not another game).

This major change of plans is also why we weren't able to deliver the second Dev Plan announcement. As for Kiki's release timing and the upcoming project, we'll be sharing more news in the coming months.

[b]Why is Taego being removed from Featured Map and added to the rotation from Season 14?[/b]
While Taego has been a popular selection as the Featured Map for some regions, we understand that for others, the matchmaking experience hasn’t been as positive.

Currently, our matchmaking system doesn’t facilitate unique Featured Map settings per region, but we’re actively developing this feature and plan to release it alongside our next map. This will allow us to implement more region-specific matchmaking solutions.

[b]Why are Miramar and Erangel in Ranked Mode permanently?[/b]
Erangel and Miramar are the two maps most synonymous with PUBG Esports and Ranked, known and loved by both players and viewers alike; we intend for them to be mainstays.
  
[b]Why are you making us play the smaller maps like Sanhok, Karakin, and Paramo in Ranked?[/b]
Ranked is intended to be the competitive version of Normal Mode, with small maps included. While we understand this is a point of contention within the community, we’re still actively monitoring player sentiment and can still make additional adjustments to certain gameplay settings used, such as max player numbers. Please keep the feedback coming.

[b]Why isn't Haven a part of Ranked?[/b]
Haven is our smallest map, coming in at 1x1 km. Due to its size, unique gameplay mechanics, and feedback after implementing Squads, we found Haven wasn’t the right fit for Ranked. With that said, we’re still exploring how we can best utilize Haven and its unique features in the future.
  
[b]How will this map rotation plan work if a new map gets released?[/b]
We’ll share details on our next map and how it fits into the updated matchmaking system closer to its release.

See you on the Battlegrounds.

PUBG: Battlegrounds Team

newsitems.title: Welcome to PUBG Global Championship 2021
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=YyWP_Lw6Lng;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello PUBG Esports fans! 

PUBG esports finale of the year, PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2021 is soon approaching!

32 teams from four different regions that have gone through a year-long of fierce competition have finally made their way to the final battlegrounds to battle out the global number one team.

Read on for full details of the tournament and more

[h1][b]PGC 2021 [/b][b]Tournament Structure[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54ebd57005beb5f15afbe0b5506b68672b20b0d2.png[/img]

The PUBG Global Championship (PGC 2021) will begin its journey with a Rank decision match on Nov 19th and ending with a Grand Final ending on Dec 19th. Just like PGI.S earlier this year, PGC 2021 will be a LAN/Online hybrid tournament. The 32 qualified teams from around the globe will be invited to Paradise City in Incheon, Korea to compete for a prize pool of over 2 Million USD. Teams will also benefit from the sales of PGC store items, with 30% of the profit being added into the event prize pool. 

Now, let's get into the details of the tournament structure.

[h1][b]Tournament Structure[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]Rank Decision[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2043b6f75b7f73381f99b4c8170ecb169a43adbc.png[/img]

PGC 2021 starts with Rank Decision matches on Nov 19th as teams fight for entry positions 1st through 32nd for the upcoming Weekly Survival.

Prior to the Rank Decision matches, teams will be divided into four groups. Group selection will take place once teams invited to Korea have completed their quarantine. The results will be announced via the PUBG Esports website approximately a week before the Rank Decision.

After the group selection, teams will go through a full league to compete with other groups for 3 days, 6 matches per day. Based on the outcomes of the Rank Decision, teams will be lined up from 1st to 32nd to prepare for the Weekly Survival series.

[h2][b]Weekly Series: Weekly Survival & Weekly Final & BOTTOM 16[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bc6ab9855dbd2af92d28265d9ec6ce89167701d2.png[/img]
[b]Weekly Survival[/b]
Now things get serious.

Weekly Survival matches are 16 matches played over 3 days. The objective here will be to battle against 16 teams and become the last team standing. Each match, the team which wins the Chicken Dinner will advance through to the Weekly Finals. The remaining 15 teams will be joined by the next team from the BOTTOM 16 list and another match begins until all 16 slots are all filled in the Weekly Finals.

*As an exception, Weekly Survival matches and the Grand Survival will feature WWCD format and not use SUPER Point Rule.

[h3][b]Weekly Final[/b][/h3]
The 16 winners of the Weekly Survival matches will compete in a 10 match tournament over the weekend. 

Here, the tournament will follow the traditional PUBG Esports tournament structure and SUPER Point Rule. Teams will be competing to earn points which will be crucial for advancing onto the Grand Finals.
[list]    [*]The winner of each Weekly Final will be granted with GUARANTEED slot at Grand Final[/*]    [*]The winner of each Weekly Final will be granted with a special Weekly Winner prize of $30,000.[/*][/list][h3][b]BOTTOM 16[/b][/h3]
The remaining 16 teams which failed to advance onto the Weekly Finals will compete in the BOTTOM 16 matches which take place on the upcoming Monday, after the Weekly Final.
[list]    [*]The BOTTOM 16 is composed of a total of 5 matches to determine the next lineup for next week's waiting list for Weekly Survival. [/*][/list]
[h2][b]The Grand Final & Grand Survival[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f2f6e3d38ed21807a0a22841b0fcb756d649d638.png[/img]

Last but not least, the Grand Finals. Top 16 battle-hardened veterans will be pushed to their limits in the final battle for the PGC throne.

[h3][b]Winner of Weekly Finals[/b][/h3]
[list]    [*]The winner of each Weekly Finals (3 teams) will earn a slot at Grand Final[/*][/list]
[b]Top 9 teams [/b]
[list]    [*]The top 9 teams with the highest overall points from the Weekly Finals will advance to the Grand Finals[list]            [*]If the same team manages to win more than a week, the next team in line will advance to the Grand Finals.[/*]            [*]E.g. Team A wins W1 & W2 → Top 10 teams will advance to Grand Finals[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]The Grand Survival[/b]

A day before the Grand Finals, Grand Survival will be held with the remaining 19 teams, excluding the teams already qualified for the Grand Finals, to select the winners of the remaining seats.
[list]    [*]Grand Survival consists of 4 matches[/*]    [*]The winner of each match will secure their spot in the Grand Finals.[/*][/list]
*As an exception, Weekly Survival matches and the Grand Survival will feature WWCD format and not use SUPER Point Rule.

[h3][b]The Grand Final[/b][/h3]
The 16 teams successfully advanced to the Grand Finals will be challenged to compete in the final battle to claim the throne. 
[list]    [*]The Grand Final will take place over 3 days with 5 matches per day.[/*]    [*]PGC 2021 final rankings will be decided based on the final placements from the Grand Final[/*]    [*]Remaining teams that have failed to advance to the Grand Final will be ranked based on their accumulated points from Weekly Finals.[/*][/list]
[h1][b]Prize Pool [/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9f979ac380dadfb77e129a63a1b5cd87d5560f0e.png[/img]

The total prize pool of the PGC 2021 starts with 2 Million USD which will be distributed by the participating teams final results of the tournament. Similar to previous events, 30% of all PGC 2021 item sales contribute towards the total prize pool via crowdfunding.

[h3][b]Special Prizes[/b][/h3]
[list]    [*][b]Weekly Series Winner ($30,000 per Week)[/b][/*]    [*][b]KILL LEADER ($10,000)[/b]        [list]            [*]Prize granted to the player with the most kills[/*]            [*]Prize will be distributed evenly in the case of a tie[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]ALL-PGC TEAM ($20,000)[/b]        [list]            [*]Prize granted to the 4 best performing players in the Series ($5,000 per player)[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]INSANE SQUAD ($20,000)[/b]        [list]            [*]Prize granted to the team which showed the most impressive moment in the tournament[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][b]PGC 2021 Item sales profits[/b]
All participating teams will benefit from 30% of the profits earned from the sale of PGC 2021 store items. Profits will be distributed to the teams based on their final tournament rank. Picking up some PGC 2021 exclusive gear will not only help support your favorite teams directly, but also will provide you with voting coupons for the upcoming Pick'em Challenge. More information on PGC 2021 Pick'em Challenge will be available soon!

For everything PUBG Esports, visit [url=http://pubgesports.com/]PUBGEsports.com[/url]

newsitems.title: Updates to the PGC 2021 Participating Teams and more
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4618d87ca4ddf7a7a4b3707c5853203098b3ef2e.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans.

The 2021 PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP draws near! Teams from around the world are already en route to Korea for the November 19th showdown, so it's time to disclose a bit more about the tournament and teams you can expect to see! 

[h2][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h2]
PGC 2021 will be a LAN/Online hybrid tournament similar to how PGI.S was run.
[list]    [*]In PGC 2021, 5 teams from CHINA will participate on-line.[/*]    [*]All other teams will be invited to participate in-person in Korea.[/*][/list]
Ideally, we'd love all teams to be together for this tournament, but unfortunately some visa issues have prevented that this year. So this year, all Chinese teams will play together in their own arena, while the rest of the teams play together in Korea.

Both PGC arenas in Korea and China will be equipped with identical gaming setups to guarantee that teams have an equal environment to compete. In addition, both arenas will be supervised by PUBG Esports referees to ensure a fair and transparent tournament.

All teams who qualified for PGC 2021 and are traveling to Korea and will be safely quarantined, following national quarantine guidelines. They will remain in the isolation facility for the next two weeks until the tournament begins.


[h2][b]Update to the Participating Teams[/b][/h2]
[list]    [*]Unfortunately, team Unicorn Phoenix Da Nang from APAC region will not be able to participate in PGC 2021 due to difficulties in acquiring a visa.        [list]            [*]UNP's ticket to participate in PGC 2021 has been transferred to the Vietnam team next in line, GAMEHOME Ha Dong.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2][b]Team Name U[/b][b]pdates[/b][/h2]
Some participating teams have had a name change.
[list]    [*][b]ASIA[/b]        [list]            [*](previously) Veronica7 → (now) GNL_ESPORTS[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]EUROPE[/b]        [list]            [*](previously) Question Mark → (now) Team Unique[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]AMERICA[/b]        [list]            [*](previously) FIUMBA - > (now) KPI Gaming[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h2][b]Reserve Player Announcement[/b][/h2]
Teams participating in PGC 2021 are able to acquire additional 'Reserve Players' through the following rules. 
[list]    [*]Based on the player roaster submitted during PCS5, teams with 4 or less players are able to register a maximum of 1 additional player as a 'Reserve Player'[list]            [*]Reserve Players cannot replace the empty player slot of those who have failed to acquire a visa.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The Reserve Player is a substitute player for emergencies. Reserve players can only be utilized if an existing player is unable to participate in the match[/*]    [*]These cases may include;[list]            [*]If a player is confirmed COVID-19 positive and needs to be isolated.[/*]            [*]If a player suffers from a physical injury making them unable to participate[/*]            [*]If officials rule that another reason is severe enough to warrant the swap[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/385416621caeaefa00077a88c1c8f90ab8a78c99.jpg[/img]

Hello, Survivors.

[h2]Updates for Live Server[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed the 'cancel' error message that pops up during matchmaking.
[*] Fixed the issue of a player's weapon getting holstered after player gets off a vehicle after using healing/boosting item in the driver's seat.
[*] Fixed the audio issue of an observer being able to hear gun shots from a player who isn't shooting.
[*] Fixed the issue of the sentence on the bottom of the Ranked mode results screen being cut off after the game language is set to English.
[*] Fixed the issue of the Night Hunter Mask's color looking different from the Store's banner image color.
[*]The issue where the Self-AED disappears instantly when it is used immediately after coming out of the water in DBNO conditions when teammate(s) is alive.  
[*]The issue where if you use Self-AED on the ground after being downed while swimming, you get killed instantly when there are no teammates. [/list]

[h2]14.2 Highlights[/h2]

[previewyoutube=L7YeolUO158;full][/previewyoutube]

New Weapon: M79 can be found, not only in Taego but across all eight maps.

The new Taego weapon Mortar is easy to use in combat situations, but it can take a lot of practice to achieve reasonable accuracy. First, you must calculate the distance to the target and the expected movement path, so calculate carefully. Once you get used to it, it can be helpful to attack behind ridges where grenades can’t reach or when defending specific areas. Also, it can be effective when destroying the trunk of a vehicle. In particular, you can use various strategies in cooperative play, so be sure to use them in battle!

newsitems.title: PUBG LABS: Halloween Battle Royale
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d29538daaeca84be84e27b000a83fb7663b3f378.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

With only a few weeks before the ancient ghost-chasing Celtic festival of Samhain - yes, Halloween - we want to drop a little surprise into your candy pockets. First of all... do you remember Fantasy Battle Royale? Fantasy Battle Royale was first released as an experimental "prank" mode for April Fools' Day, but the popularity of the mode was so explosive that the service was extended for another week!

So for this Halloween, we've decided to resurrect last year's Fantasy Battle Royale from its legendary ruins and polish it into a spookier version and name: PUBG LABS is back with Halloween Battle Royale!

Are you ready to charge into the spine-chilling Battlegrounds?

[h2]What is Halloween Battle Royale?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5becc3ca8cad21b28caf1961c5e8404e8220a543.jpg[/img]

Players will be asked to transform into their preferable class, aboard the Ghost Ship (yup, not a plane!), jump down into Erangel's darkness, and fight to be the last one standing. Pretty easy, huh? It's the same old battle royale but you're all simply placed in a fantastical setting. Let's now take a look at Halloween Battle Royale's basic rules and features.
[list]    [*]Players can enter Halloween Battle Royale mode by pressing the LABS banner in the main lobby.[/*]    [*]Once matchmaking is done, a window will pop up where players can choose to be either an Executioner, Ranger, Pyromancer, or Cleric.[list]            [*]Players will have time to choose their class in the pre-game lobby; they can also bring the class window back up by pressing F8 for PC or X for Console.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The first circle will be shown on the map once players hop on the Ghost Ship.[list]            [*]At the same time, players will be equipped with their respective class's Level 1 weapon, ring, and necklace.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players will have to loot ingredients to upgrade their weapons.[/*]    [*]Fight foes with your class skills, show great teamwork with your squad, and win Halloween Battle Royale.[/*][/list]
[h2]Halloween Battle Royale Classes[/h2]
Now's the time to introduce the four different classes: Executioner, Ranger, Pyromancer, or Cleric. Since there are no limits to the number of a certain class in a single squad, teammates should get tactical and put their heads together to think about what combination they could come up with.

However, keep in mind that each class requires its own exclusive ingredients to grow stronger! Therefore, it would be efficient to share loot among different classes, but it's obviously not the best to share the loot you would need if your squad is made up of four Executioners.

Another important note: once players upgrade their Level 1 weapons to Level 2, they can choose between two different types of weapons. Each weapon has different skills so make sure to craft and wield wisely! But do not fear; players can switch between the two weapons in every upgrade stage.

[h2]Executioner[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/10e4ba2c28f0ae866187ad069d6e1dbed00d7483.jpg[/img]
[b][i]"I'm here for the SLAUGHTERFEST!"[/i][/b]

An Executioner is your classic melee warrior that can chase down or pull enemies in for brutal combat.
[list]    [*]Default Weapon: Axe of Swiftness[list]            [*]Executioners can dash towards enemies.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Halberd of Restraint[list]            [*]Executioners can pull in enemies within a certain area.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]Executioners also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.
[list]    [*]Stun Ball: Stuns enemies for 2 seconds.[/*]    [*]Liquid Courage: Enhances moving speed and boosts HP for a certain amount of time.[/*][/list]
[h2]Ranger[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/65720924a7b5aaa70f257864f04476d150983adc.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"Always stay alert. I might come for you from atop the trees, the thickest undergrowth, or from right behind you."[/b][/i]

A Ranger can either become a sniper who deals damage from afar or a stealthy assassin that dives in for a sneak attack.
[list][*]Default Weapon: Fatal Crossbow
[list][*]Powerful long-range weapon.[/list][*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Blade of Invisibility[list][*]Short-ranged melee weapon that allows Rangers to turn invisible for a certain amount of time.[*]Attacking enemies from behind or during an invisible state will apply more damage.[/list][/list]Rangers also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.[list][*] Snare Trap: Rangers can set up traps and root enemies for 5 seconds.[*] Stun Grenade: The same old stun grenade.[/list]
[h2]Pyromancer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/57cb4d2f3b0e619b1f311b4eda83ba015b0453db.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"Aah... the smell of burning flesh."[/b][/i]

A Pyromancer specializes in assaulting multiple enemies at once with deadly fire.
[list][*]Default Weapon: Gloves of Calamity
[list][*]Allows Pyromancers to attack with Fireballs.
[*]Deals great damage but is difficult to wield.[/list][*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Hellfire Cannon[list][*]Can fire infinitely.[*]May overheat and be unusable for a certain amount of time if continuously used.[/list][/list]Pyromancers also cast spells throughout the game.[list][*] Firewall: Generates large firewalls to block the enemy's path.
[*] Meteor Shower: Generates powerful meteors. This can only be activated when the Pyromancer's necklace is Level 3 or above.[/list]
[h2]Cleric[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e2ae1d5d2e804ad61ea29bf87e18e96ed4d72f9c.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"I'm not a nice doctor; BLEED to HEAL!"[/b][/i]

A Cleric is an aggressive healer that can lock in melee combat.

[list][*]Default Weapon: Mace of Suffering and Aegis of Light
[list][*]The Mace of Suffering is a melee weapon that causes enemies to bleed for a certain amount of time.
[*]Using the Mace of Suffering on teammates will restore their HP.
[*]The Aegis of Light blocks crossbow attacks.[/list]
[*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Triage Shotgun
[list][*]Shooting teammates will restore their HP.
[*]Shooting enemies will debuff them and cause slight damage.[/list][/list]
Clerics also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.
[list][*]Vitality Bomb: Restores HP.
[*]First Aid Kit: Healing item that can be shared with teammates.[/list]
[h2]Items and Crafting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/039121f028760692eb85a076ebfcddb8743df299.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Halloween Battle Royale has its own set of items spawned throughout the map, so players won't be finding any weapons, ammo, throwables, boosts, or equipment.
[list][*]However, bandages will spawn.
[*]The items that players will find will mostly be ingredients to upgrade weapons, rings, and necklaces.[/list][*]Each class-specific weapon, ring, and necklace given to the players at the beginning cannot be dropped or traded.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/98931ee1197c8defa42a1ba2e6af0a02f768b4ab.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Players can open the crafting window by pressing Tab.
[*]The looted ingredients are used to upgrade players' weapons, ring, and necklace.
[*]Players can right-click to upgrade craftable items (which will glow up).
[*]Since each class has two weapons, players will be shown two weapon-crafting routes.
[list][*]Each class's Level 1 weapon is set as default but starting from Level 2, players can choose to craft to either of the two weapons (Ex. Players can craft a Executioner's Level 1 Axe to Level 2 Axe OR Level 2 Halberd).[/list][/list]
[h2]Treasure Chests (Care Packages)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9755fe9726d1fc04d606f06437be1279bc0680d6.jpg[/img]
Treasure falling from the sky! The care packages will be looking like Treasure Chests in Halloween Battle Royale.
[list][*] Treasure Chests contain general and Level 5 crafting ingredients.
[*] Dropped Treasure Chests will be marked on the map.
[*] Players will have to damage the Treasure Chest to open it.
[*] The squad that successfully opens and interacts with the Treasure Chest is given an invincibility buff for 10 seconds.[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/88b5bd6c35a637625627fdb95bead8d2596bf3c0.jpg[/img][list][*]Instead of normal vehicles and planes, Halloween Battle Royale will only have the "Night Slayer" UAZ and Ghost Ships.
[*]Vehicles' speed and HP were nerfed in this mode to prompt more dynamic gameplay.[/list]
[h2]Service Schedule[/h2]

PUBG LABS: Halloween Battle Royale will be open during the following period:

[b]PC & Console[/b][list][*] PDT: October 19, 10 PM - November 1, 12 AM
[*] CEST/CET: October 20, 7 AM - November 1, 8 AM
[*] KST: October 20, 2 PM - November 1, 4 PM[/list][h2]Gameplay Settings[/h2]
[list][*] Map: Erangel
[*] TPP Only
[*] 20 Squads of 4 (Max. 80 players per match)
[*] Halloween Battle Royale only supports 4-Man Squads
[list][*] It will automatically find teammates for you if you're not a full squad[/list][/list][h2]Notes When Playing in LABS[/h2]
[list][*] LABS games do not provide XP or gameplay rewards
[*] LABS gameplay will not be reflected on the Career page
[*] LABS gameplay will not be reflected on Match History
[*] LABS gameplay will not count towards Survivor Pass missions
[*] LABS gameplay does not support replay[/list]
We hope you have the best Halloween with LABS: Halloween Battle Royale!

See you on the Battlegrounds.

PUBG: Battlegrounds Team

newsitems.title: PC PATCH NOTES - UPDATE 14.1
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7919af81413a965491722e703d40f79003f6748d.png[/img]

Hello, Survivors. First up in this update is the ability to pick up and carry a downed survivor. You can now throw them over your shoulders and bring them with you to victory. 

Next up, Taego has received a lot of changes. Additional covers are added in some areas, and the terrain has also received improvements. Furthermore, Breakable Pots have items inside so break and loot! Error Space are special new zones marked on the map that can spawn items featured in other Battlegrounds, so make sure to check the map for locations. 

In addition, Taego and Paramo have been added to the Ranked. The rulesets have also been changed accordingly, so check out the details below. Many changes have been made to Erangel’s hot place Pochinki, along with the Pony Coupe and Porter, Halloween decor and weather on Erangel, the new Trick-or-Treat Progressive M416, and more, so be sure to check them out below for full details.

[h2][b]14.1 HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=56DgdrQhbOg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]TAEGO UPDATES[/b][/h2][b]TAEGO WORLD IMPROVEMENTS[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e9837e0b4d7e9a6a6f6236201a252b3893a478a4.jpg[/img]
Since the introduction of Taego, we have been continuously analyzing the play history to collect information about the overly advantageous areas on the map. As a result, we discovered that some regions of Taego have a relatively high win rate compared to others. 

After checking the win rate of the most popular combat zones, objects and terrain improvements were made for the areas with a win rate of 75% or more.
[list][*]Improvements[list][*]Added cover to the mountain area north of the Palace and the river area east of the Terminal.[list][*]Fixed field of view, bends, and cover for areas where terrain composition is difficult to overcome.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improved the cliff topography in the north of Buk San Sa area.[list][*]Corrected the height of the cliffside terrain, which was considered to be OP.[/*][/list][/*][*]Reorganization of the topography around the School area.[list][*]After removing the surrounding trees, added fields.[/*][/list][/*][*]Covers and hills have been reorganized.[list][*]Terrain improvements in some coastal areas.[list][*]Redline: Corrected the cliff topography of the entire coast.[/*][*]Blueline: Removed rocks located around the lighthouse.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Some mountain/river areas:[list][*]Green area: Added trees to the hillside.[/*][*]Magenta Zone: Added flat terrain curves.[/*][*]Sky Blue Zones: Added cover for areas that lack cover.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]ERROR SPACE [/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e2a716d16a837a751428f76ce8bbdebeaf3f115e.jpg[/img]
Introducing the Error Space, this map exclusive feature to Taego allows players to gather other map-exclusive weapons and supplies to be spawned randomly within these zones.

Error Space zones are displayed randomly on the minimap and will be active until the end of the match, so make sure you head to the Error Space early so you don’t miss out! 

Game Modes:
 Custom Match
 – Players can set the number of Error Spaces.
 – Players can set the spawning probability of Error Spaces.
[h2][b]BREAKABLE POT[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0690260f77aba57abe3d89c8d4e9592091c3e135.jpg[/img]
Various items are placed in Breakable Pots that are placed all over the map. Break the pot to loot multiple items inside and lead the match to victory. However, be aware that the sound of breaking the pot may expose your location to enemies. You may break the pot by punching it, but a few shots with your gun can come in handy.
[list][*]Game Modes[list][*]Normal Match[/*][*]Ranked[/*][*]Custom Match[/*][/list][/*][*]Spawned Items[list][*]Medical Items[list][*]First Aid Kit[/*][*]Bandage[/*][/list][/*][*]Boost Items[list][*]Adrenaline Syringe[/*][*]Painkillers[/*][*]Energy Drink[/*][/list][/*][*]Throwables[list][*]Frag Grenade[/*][*]Smoke Grenade[/*][*]Stun Grenade[/*][*]Molotov Cocktail[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]COMEBACK BR AND UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c2fbeec8f06dbd06e4c87ac44eebff5bc8573179.jpg[/img]
We received much feedback on the inconvenient situations that players experienced while waiting for Comeback BR. Therefore, to provide a better overall experience, we have made the following improvements.
[list][*]UI Improvements[list][*]A warning message will be displayed when trying to leave while spectating Comeback BR.[/*][*]If you die while being able to participate in Comeback BR, “Exit to lobby” button will be disabled for three seconds.[/*][*]A timer that indicates the time left until the start of Comeback BR will be displayed.[/*][*]Comeback BR team UI improvements[list][*]Nicknames are now displayed brighter for squadmates who are waiting for Comeback BR to begin.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]VEHICLE BALANCE UPDATES[/b][/h2]
We gave high low-end torque and excellent stability in consideration of the rugged and mountainous terrains of Taego for its exclusive vehicles. Also, Taego is very difficult to travel without a vehicle. So we have max speeds to prevent them from being destroyed easily from attacks. However, we have listened to the voices of our community saying the top speeds were too fast, so we have reduced the top speeds of the vehicles.
[list][*]Pony Coupe[list][*]Normal: Reduced from 140km/h to under 130km/h.[/*][*]Boost: Reduced from 150km/h to under 140km/h. [/*][/list][/*][*]Porter[list][*]Normal: No changes are applied.[/*][*]Boost: Reduced from 130km/h to under 120km/h.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]RANKED RULESET[/b][/h2][list][*]Leaver Penalty[list][*]The leaver penalty should be applied for players who have died and are qualified for the Comeback BR but choose to leave the match without waiting for the Comeback BR to begin.[/*][*]Leaver penalty is applied when leaving match during Comeback BR[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]ERANGEL UPDATES[/b][/h2][b]POCHINKI [/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/19c8f6a5086a4d2bf88f7c440a0eedea4cbc71ff.jpg[/img]
An update has been made to Pochinki, one of the most popular drop points for dropping on Erangel. Until now, it was challenging to escape from Pochinki after early match combat without a vehicle. Also, the surrounding area was made up of fields, which made it easy for the enemies to find you. The following updates have been made to address these difficulties. Last but not least, the quality of the terrain around the map has been improved.
[list][*]Pochinki Church Renewal[list][*]In order to balance with the surrounding two or three-story buildings, we have blocked the church rooftop play.[/*][*]Added a secret room in the basement of the church where items are spawned. This room can be accessed without a key. [/*][/list][/*][*]Updated Terrain Around Pochinki[list][*]Added waterway.[/*][*]Added cover.[/*][*]Added fences.[/*][*]Fixed terrain height. [/*][/list][/*][*]Improved Pochinki Terrain Quality.[/*][/list][h2][b]HALLOWEEN UPDATES[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/52e2522c15de11faa4b5c54953006685536ad0bd.jpg[/img]
Trick or treat! It’s that season of the year again. To maximize the Halloween vibes, we have finished decorating some parts of Erangel. Knock on the door and shout out trick or treat!
[list][*]School, Hospital, and the Starting island area have been decorated with the Halloween concept.[/*][*]Halloween-themed weather, with unique moon color and fog in certain areas, is added.[list][*]Game Modes[list][*]Normal match[/*][*]Custom match[/*][/list][/*][*]Weather Probability[list][*]Halloween: 30[/*][*]Clear: 50[/*][*]Cloudy: 20[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Care Package Smoke Color[list][*]Changed to Halloween colors.[list][*]Flaregun supply crates are not included.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Placed Mummy Coffins at School, Hospital, and the Starting Island.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/747441f75eee07e8b78b53470b4b8b7c87f6ee98.jpg[/img][h2][b]NEW FEATURE: CARRY[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/24a0196fb602e791275a100047563091678c11e8.jpg[/img]
Making its way to the Battlegrounds this update is the new Carry feature. Be the hero your team deserves by risking it all to carry an ally to safety or take a downed enemy on the adventure of a lifetime – before they bleed out, that is. 

There are pros and cons to picking up a downed player. For one, they’ll serve as a sort of human shield, guarding you against some incoming fire (pro for you, con for them…), but in return, you will not be able to sprint, jump, crouch, prone or hurdle, so make sure you choose your rescue route carefully. You can still fire while carrying a player, but your options are reduced to hip fire only. As for the carried player themselves, their bleed out time will be lowered, and they’ll also be able to spot for you, though their visibility will be limited to whichever way you turn them.
[list][*]Available on all maps.[/*][*]You may pick up any downed player (friend or foe) that is not currently self-reviving or being revived.[/*][*]While carrying a player, the following is true:[list][*]The following cannot be used.[list][*] Panzerfaust[/*][*]Melee weapons[/*][*]Throwables (includes Gas/Jerry Can)[/*][*]Emergency Pickup[/*][*]Emergency Parachute[/*][/list][/*][*]You and the carried player still take damage separately.[/*][*]Your movement speed remains the same. However, you cannot crouch, go prone, sprint, jump, or hurdle.[/*][*]You may still fire your weapon, but from the hip only.[/*][*]You may not use healing items.[/*][*]You may not use throwables.[/*][/list][/*][*]While being carried a player, the following is true:[list][*]Your field of vision is limited to the direction your carrier is facing you.[/*][/list][/*][*]Carried players cannot join you in a vehicle.[/*][*]When the Carrier starts to swim Carry is canceled and the carried person drops/sinks to the bottom.[/*][*]You cannot attach to an Emergency Pickup while carrying a player.[/*][*]You may not use an Emergency Parachute while carrying a player.[/*][/list][h2][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3a326a270ea5c2076e392ad711045574bcad3aca.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Normal Match[list][*]As-is: Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, Vikendi , Karakin[/*][*]To-be: Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, Taego, Paramo[/*][/list][/*][*]Ranked[list][*]As-is: Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, Vikendi [/*][*]To-be: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Paramo[/*][/list][/*][/list]
As the Taego and Paramo are added to the Ranked, a separate ruleset is set for Ranked Mode.
[list][*]Taego[list][*]Maximum Players: 64[/*][*]Blue Zone: Same as Normal Matches.[/*][*]Care Package: Same as Normal Matches.[/*][*]Red Zone: Not available.[/*][*]Vehicle Spawn: Added fixed spawning locations.[list][*]Only Pony Coupes are spawned in Garages.[/*][/list][/*][*]Item Spawn: Same as Normal Matches.[/*][*]Flare Gun: Only available to call in a custom airdrop. BRDM-2 won’t be dropped. [/*][/list][/*][*]Paramo[list][*]Maximum Players: 32[/*][*]Blue Zone: Seven Phases.[/*][*]Item Spawn Increase.[/*][*]Vehicle Spawn:[list][*]Normal Matches: Buggy[/*][*]Ranked: Rony[list][*]Rony is spawned from fixed spawning locations.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Red Zone: Not available.[/*][*]Weather: Clear.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]RANKED SEASON 14[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/324abf343646f37567b78524501e4d85343d5fea.jpg[/img][h2][b]SEASON 13 RANKED MODE REWARDS[/b][/h2]

Season 13 rewards are granted based on your final end-of-season rank.

newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c150cb38b3035c4176df00724a0d1fbc92f752ea.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Your screenshots and videos of you all posing and catwalking through our latest map, Taego, surely plastered smiles on our faces. In commemoration of Taego’s release, we hosted an [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/07/30/lets-play-taego-hashtag-event/]event [/url]last month that asked our players to submit their various works to earn the opportunity of winning 1,000 G-Coins! As the creators of Taego, we were able to reminisce the detailed spots and corners of the map through our players’ lenses.

It’s now time to announce the results, and we sincerely wish

to thank every single participant foremost for taking their time to take part in our Let’s Play Taego Hashtag Event. And so, the winners are…!

newsitems.title: Introducing: PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2021
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a11035878cc61e98763e59e923b486cbf8bb3412.png[/img]

Hello PUBG Esports fans,

The year 2021 was another tough one due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, but we’ve done our best to continue PUBG Esports globally by hosting PGI.S and 2 PUBG Continental Series events. We are now announcing the return of our beloved finale of PUBG Esports, the PUBG Global Championship 2021.

[h2][b]PGC 2021[/b][/h2]
The PUBG Global Championship (PGC 2021) will be held this upcoming November. Like PGI.S earlier this year, PGC 2021 will be a LAN/Online hybrid tournament. Teams from outside of the tournament region will be invited to fly to Paradise City in Incheon, Korea.

Running from November 19th to December 19th, 32 of the finest teams from around the globe will be competing for a prize pool of over $2 Million USD. Again, PGC will have 30% of the profit earned from PGC items sales added directly to the prize pool so that teams will benefit from the fans’ support.

12 Teams from Asia, 8 teams from Europe, 6 teams from APAC, and 6 teams from the Americas region will be invited. The exact list of participating teams will be determined based on PGC Qualification Points gathered throughout the year once PCS5 concludes.

[h2][b]TOURNAMENT FORMAT[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2a71eac4e63abd079b64a22c43f51f2915cdd5f8.png[/img]
PGC 2021 will consist of a 5-week long tournament including 1 week of Rank Decision, 3 weeks of Weekly League, and a Grand Final during the last week.

[b]RANK DECISION[/b]
[list]    [*]Preliminary Rank Decision matches will take place during the very first week to decide which 16 teams will start in the first Weekly Survival.[/*][/list]
[b]WEEKLY SURVIVAL[/b]
[list]    [*]16 Weekly Survival matches will be played over 3 days during the week. Teams must win a Chicken Dinner to advance to the Weekly Finals.[/*]    [*]The remaining 15 teams from each lobby will be joined by the next team in line from the Bottom 16 waiting list.[/*][/list]
[b]WEEKLY FINAL[/b]

A total of 10 matches will be played over two days, and the best team will automatically earn a spot in the Grand Final.
[list]    [*]The winning team from each Weekly Final (3 teams total) will earn a spot in the Grand Final[/*]    [*]The top 9 teams with highest points accumulated across all 3 weeks of Weekly Finals will also advance to the Grand Final[/*]    [*]The remaining teams that did not advance to the Grand Final will participate in the Grand Survival. Teams who win a Chicken Dinner in each of the 4 matches in the Grand Survival will fill the remaining Grand Final spots.[/*][/list]
[b]GRAND FINAL[/b]

The 16 qualified teams will compete in a 15-match tournament over 3 days.
[list]    [*]The Grand Final standings based on SUPER Point Rule will determine the Grand Champion of PGC 2021.[/*][/list][h2][b]THE SCORING SYSTEM[/b][/h2]
PUBG Esports announced the adoption of a new scoring method with the MC Rule back in April which was applied to PCS4 and PCS5.

We sought to add more fun and excitement to the tournament and to promote the core identity of the Battle Royale genre, Survival. However, the rule change caused some unintended side effects. Matches became more monotonous, and teams suffered from the excess pressure to earn Chicken Dinners.

After collecting feedback from fans and through a deep discussion with PUBG teams around the world, we’ve made the following decision regarding the PUBG Esports scoring system.

[b]WE HUMBLY WELCOME AND APPRECIATE FEEDBACK FROM THE FANS AND TEAMS.PUBG ESPORTS WILL READAPT THE SUPER POINT RULE STARTING WITH PGC 2021.[/b]
[list]    [*]As an exception, the Weekly Survival matches will feature WWCD format and not use SUPER Point Rule.[/*]    [*]All other matches will use the SUPER Point Rule and consider both placement points and kill points.[/*]    [*]The final rankings will be decided by SUPER Point Rule using both placement points and kill points.[/*][/list]
The PUBG Esports team truly believes that it is most important to provide fun and exciting matches to the fans while providing a competitive, but also enjoyable, environment to the participating players. We will continue to accept and evaluate your feedback.

More details on PGC 2021 will be announced after PCS5.

PUBG Esports Team.

newsitems.title: PUBG LABS: Zone Tag Again
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c67e6e7e7a83ab46d0c566ba49cfc61a1799c8fc.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

The battle for the Blue Ball is back. PUBG presents to you LABS: Zone Tag Again! Since the first version of Zone Tag that was released this February was quite experimental for us as well, we've utilized our players' feedback thereafter and made some both big and small changes that would hopefully suit your tastes.

Let's now take a look at those changes.

[h2][b]LABS: Zone Tag Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e8c18061c8d8dbb3f24027884eb75593c99f9825.jpg[/img]

[b]HEALTH REGENERATION[/b]
[list]    [*]To make things fairer, all players can now regenerate health based on their movement speed (also works inside vehicles). The faster you move, the more health you regenerate per second.[/*][/list]
[b]OVERALL LOOT[/b]
[list]    [*]We’ve increased the overall amount of loot as we noticed that players were not able to find enough loot within phases of the game.[/*]    [*]We also removed boost items as everyone can regenerate HP based on movement speed.[/*][/list]
[b]THE ANCHOR[/b]
[list]    [*]An Anchor will spawn if the Carrier stays in one area for too long.[/*]    [*]The area radius of the Anchor gets larger with every circle phase.[/*]    [*]The Blue Ball will get detached if the Carrier does not move away from the Anchor.[/*][/list]
[b]BOATS AND AQUARAILS[/b]
[list]    [*]Boats and Aquarails will spawn.[/*]    [*]The Carrier however cannot enter water, nor use boats or Aquarails.[/*][/list]
For more details on the general rules of Zone Tag, check out our [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/02/02/labs-zone-tag/]previous announcement[/url].

[h2][b]SERVICE SCHEDULE[/b][/h2]
PUBG LABS: Zone Tag will be open during the following period.
[list]    [*]PC[list]            [*]PDT: September 8, 0 AM – September 13, 0 AM[/*]            [*]CEST: September 8, 9 AM – September 13, 9 AM[/*]            [*]KST: September 8, 4 PM – September 13, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PDT: September 16, 0 AM – September 20, 0 AM[/*]            [*]CEST: September 16, 9 AM – September 20, 9 AM[/*]            [*]KST: September 16, 4 PM – September 20, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2][b]GAMEPLAY SETTINGS[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Erangel – Sunny[/*]    [*]FPP & Squad Only[list]            [*]One-Man Squads Not Supported[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Minimum number of players: 24 (PC/Console)[/*]    [*]Maximum number of players: 100 (PC/Console)[/*][/list]
[h2][b]NOTES WHEN PLAYING IN LABS[/b][/h2][list]    [*]LABS games do not provide XP or gameplay rewards[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on the Career page[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on Match History[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not count towards Survivor Pass missions[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay does not support replay[/*][/list]

newsitems.title: PCS5 Pick'em Challenge
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6ffd52680563cc6fcb0e601821e75e77336a8f05.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

The final battle for PGC, PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES 5 is just around the corner! PCS5 will be commencing on September 16th; stay tuned to the final battle of the best teams across the globe to the PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP.

Read on to learn more about how to participate, watch and support your favorite teams!

[h2][b]PUBG ESPORTS TAB[/b][/h2]
The PUBG Esports tab is back with PCS5! Tab will be open for service starting from September 8th for PC and September 16th for Console. 

Check out the tabs to get information on your favorite players and teams, match schedules, tournament stats, and more. 

Take a deep dive into key performance indicators from regional qualifiers and find out which teams and players to keep an eye on once the tournament gets underway, and help make your best predictions for the Pick’em Challenge. 

[h2][b]ESPORTS ITEMS[/b][/h2]
[list]    [*]PCS5 Ultimate Bundle (5 voting coupon)    [/*]    [*]PCS5 Power Pack (3 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Squad Wipe Set (1 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Gear Box (1 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Parachute & Pick’em Coupon (1 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Shrapnel Scrawl SLR & Pick’em Coupon (1 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Shrapnel Scrawl Beryl & Pick’em Coupon (1 voting coupon)[/*]    [*]PCS5 Dance & Pick’em Coupon (1 voting coupon)[/*][/list]
* 30% of PUBG net sales of PCS5 items will be distributed to teams across the four regions. Half of it being added to the overall prize pool and the remaining half being distributed equally to the participating teams.

** Pick’em Challenge is not available for the Console platform. However, all PCS5 items will be available for purchase from the store.
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/PCS5-broadcasting-schedule_fullpage_v2-1024x851.jpeg[/img][list]    [*]PCS5 items sale period:[list]            [*]PC: After the maintenance on Sept 8th, 2021 – 5 pm on Sept. 30th, 2021 KST[/*]            [*]Console: 11am on Sept. 16, 2021 – 11 am on Sept. 20th, 2021 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Pick’em Challenge event period:[list]            [*]After the maintenance on Sept. 8th, 2021 – 6 pm on Sept. 30th, 2021 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Esports Shop items sale period:[list]            [*]Sept. 8th, 2021 – 11am October. 20th, 2021 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Pick’em reward claiming period:[list]            [*]Oct. 5th, 2021 – 11 am Oct. 20th, 2021 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2][b]PICK’EM CHALLENGE DETAILS[/b][/h2]
Pick’em challenge will begin on September 8th with last entries closing on September 30th 17:00 KST. Don’t forget to participate in all the challenges before it’s too late!

[h3][b]EVENT 1: PICK THE WINNER[/b][/h3]
The first event of the Pick’em challenge is to predict the four regional champions of PCS4. 

You can vote up to 7 teams out of 16 teams per region, with correct predictions granting 100,000 EP per correct regional selection. Correctly guess the winner of all four regions to win a grand total of 400,000 EP!

[h3][b]EVENT 2: TEAM FACE-OFF[/b][/h3]
The second event of the party, guess the correct winner of two rival teams to earn EP. Each region will have 4 team pairs to vote on, predict which team will perform better. This is a free event so don’t forget to make your predictions to win free rewards!

EP payouts range from 400 to 7600 depending on the vote disparity between favorite and underdog.

Check out the event summary page to take a glance at the live voting status and collect rewards.

[h3][b]FREE VOTING COUPONS AND EP![/b][/h3]
Up to 14 voting coupons can be earned by purchasing PCS5 items. However, there are plenty of opportunities to earn voting coupons and Free EP just by watching and interacting during the tournament.
[list]    [*]During PCS5 this time around, a code will pop up right after the last match of the week is over! Be quick enough to enter the code in-game to get one free voting coupon![/*]    [*]Pay close attention during PCS5 live streams, as just like in previous PCS events, you’ll occasionally see codes on-screen during the broadcast that can be redeemed for EP.[/*][/list]Participate in Pick & Go Bingo at official PUBG Esports Twitch channel 
[list]    [*]Say goodbye to good old Chicken Challenge, here comes a new Pick & Go bingo event! Select your choice of 9 teams and build your Bingo plate![/*]    [*]You can earn points from each kill your selected teams make.[list]            [*]If all teams placed in a straight line earn a kill, its a bingo! Each bingo will grant bonus point.[/*]            [*]If your choice of team placed in the center successfully wins a chicken dinner, bonus 1,000 points will be granted![/*]            [*]If your choice of team placed in the board reaches top 1-8th place, bonus placement points will be granted. Pick wisely![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Compete with randomly matched 9 other players in the chat and acquire highest point to earn free EP![/*][/list]
PCS5, the last PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES of the year! Which team will be crowned regional champion?

Jump into all the action and excitement of PCS5, PUBG Esports and the Pick’em Challenge!
