newsitems.title: Update #13.2 - Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/00b9db1bdf3ab61bbc70fa5f7f0f37dd4ce234d0.jpg[/img]

Hello, Survivors
[h2][b]13.2 Highlights[/b][/h2]
[url=https://youtu.be/vfe8dJEiYR0]https://youtu.be/vfe8dJEiYR0[/url]

[h2][b]New Weapon: P90[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54ada7304d3a6ff49ebc8a1af79e7cca1d9f2452.jpg[/img]

In this update, we are adding the fan-favorite P90 SMG to Care Packages. The P90 is our first Care Package SMG since the original Tommy Gun, and as such, we made sure it is a worthy addition. It comes loaded with its own unique 5.7mm High Powered ammo, which is capable of longer-range combat, unlike our other SMGs. It also comes with a Cheek Pad, Handguard, Laser, and Silencer pre-attached and non-detachable.

It also features dual optics that allow for fast switching between close-range and medium-range combat. Use the Holographic Sight for nearby foes and Flip on the Flipsight for added magnification when they make a run for it.

It comes paired with 250 rounds of 5.7mm ammo in the Care Package. A single magazine holds up to 50 rounds which you (and your foes) can see deplete live as you're firing due to the magazine's translucent design. With the translucent magazine keeping you aware of the high Rate of Fire and the Laser helping you keep track of your targets, the P90 is a solid addition to your loadout.
[list]    [*]Spawns on all maps[/*]    [*]Equipped with all attachments right out of the crate[list]            [*]Silencer[/*]            [*]Laser[/*]            [*]50 round magazine[/*]            [*]Non-detachable small low profile sight with some magnification[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ammo type[list]            [*]5.7mm[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Damage: 35[/*]    [*]Most Effective Distance Range: 200m-300m[/*]    [*]Rate of Fire: 1,000 RPM[/*][/list][h1][b]Taego Updates[/b][/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/612a48e8ef4beab62edc088e8b1a4e4e7969517b.jpg[/img]
Introducing the new pickup truck, Porter, exclusive on Taego! The Porter is Hyundai Motor Company's representative commercial truck, which was first introduced in 1977. Since then it has been carrying a lot of loads based on its solid basics and excellent durability. It is the only vehicle on PUBG available with the Trunk System, a new feature to be introduced below. Porter is a truck capable of carrying large loads and up to four passengers at the same time. Get your chicken dinner with the use of Porter which can easily run on any types of terrain with the support of the permanent four-wheel system!
[list]    [*]Drivetrain: All-Whee Drive[/*]    [*]Maximum number of passengers: Four[/*]    [*]Trunk System is available and the capacity is 400[/*]    [*]Maximum Speed: 130 km/h[/*]    [*]HP: 1,200 [/*]    [*]Porter replaces the UAZ[/*][/list][h2][b]New Feature: Trunk System[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cc7e440e22f47eb18d16f6eeb7ee4750e7668193.jpg[/img]
With the Trunk System, you can maximize the acquisition of items for victory on Taego. Use the compartment of the Porter to load various items and take them out when needed. If the vehicle gets blown up, all the items in the compartment will also be destroyed. If you desire to keep your items safe, make sure your vehicle is safe!
[list]    [*]Any item that can be placed in your inventory and weapons, helmets, vests, backpacks can be loaded into the Trunk.[list]            [*]However, due to the weight of weapons, helmets, vests, and bags, it may not be possible to load large quantities.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Only available on Taego with Porter vehicles.[/*]    [*]The Trunk system can be accessed with the interaction key when not onboard. When onboard, it can be accessed by opening the inventory. [/*]    [*]All items in the compartment will be lost if the vehicle is destroyed. [/*]    [*]The compartment of the vehicle does not belong to one person. Anyone can load and take out items. [/*]    [*]Item weight depending on their types are as follows.[list]            [*]When a weapon with attachments is placed in the trunk, attachment weight is added and loaded into the trunk with attachments attached.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]    [table]                    [tr]                [th][b]Item Type[/b][/th]                [th][b]Weight[/b][/th]            [/tr]                            [tr]                [td]Vest: Level 3[/td]                [td]90[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Vest: Level 2[/td]                [td]75[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Vest: Level 1[/td]                [td]60[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Helmet: Level 3[/td]                [td]60[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Helmet: Level 2[/td]                [td]50[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Helmet: Level 1[/td]                [td]40[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Backpack: Level 3[/td]                [td]62.5[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Backpack: Level 2[/td]                [td]50[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Backpack: Level 1[/td]                [td]25[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Jammer Pack[/td]                [td]100[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Main Weapons[/td]                [td]100[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Secondary Weapons[/td]                [td]16 - 20[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td]Flare Gun[/td]                [td]100[/td]            [/tr]            [/table][h2][b]New Weapon: Blue Zone Grenade[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d989cf35476e9a2b747c1cb8867db3e9e8e6149a.jpg[/img]
Introducing the Blue Zone Grenade! This throwable item can be used effectively if you want to deal damage in a broader area for a certain period of time. Especially in situations where you want to lure enemies out of a building. The Blue Zone Grenade creates a round blue zone with a maximum radius of ten meters, lasting for five seconds. It maintains its full size for five seconds, then decreases and disappears over another 5 seconds.
[list]    [*]The blue zone gets as big as ten meters in radius and lasts for five seconds.[/*]    [*]It remains in its full size for five seconds and then shrinks and disappears for another five seconds.[/*]    [*]It does not explode underwater.[list]            [*]But, when activated near water, it gives damage to players inside the water.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Damage: 10/second[/*]    [*]If you are already in the Blue Zone and are in range of an additional Blue Zone Grenade, additional damage will be applied.[list]            [*]Blue Zone + Blue Zone Grenade = Both damages apply[/*]            [*]Blue Zone Grenade + Blue Zone Grenade = Both damages apply[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]New Weather[/b][/h2]
To maximize the experience on Taego, we are adding the following weather options to Taego. They will be randomly applied. 
[list]    [*]Sunset[/*]    [*]Overcast[/*][/list][h2][b]Blue Zone Rebalancing[/b][/h2]
Based on community feedback, we decided that the first phase of the Taego Blue Zone was a bit long. Therefore, we have reduced the duration of the first phase to provide a smoother Taego play experience. Enjoy more dramatic Taego through quicker farming!
[h2][b]Comeback BR Improvements[/b][/h2]
Since the introduction of Comeback BR, we have received a lot of feedback about how it could get boring. Therefore, we have made the following changes to encourage fast-paced Comeback BRs. 
[list]    [*]Blue Zone Changes[list]            [*]Now the Bluezone will shrink even more[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Timeline changes[list]            [*]The total time of the Comeback BR has been reduced[/*]            [*]Players can return to the battlegrounds when the phase two Bluezone starts to shrink[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Mini Map Improvements[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/266523d3e361c4b205b66554d94e7112abaf4564.jpg[/img]
The Taego minimap has been updated to make it easier to identify by making the outline of the unplayable area a bit darker.
[h2][b]Custom Match Updates[/b][/h2][list]    [*][b]Rule Tab[/b] [list]            [*]Added new weather[/*]            [*]Added Comeback BR on/off option[/*]            [*]Changed the blue zone value[/*]            [*]Removed the Red Zone setting[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Spawn Tab Items[/b]        [list]            [*]Blue Zone Grenade[/*]            [*]Porter[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Sandbox Mode Items[/b]        [list]            [*]Blue Zone Grenade[/*]            [*]Porter[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]New Mode: Casual Mode[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4f21647fb4d83e981f960a4e8cec15af873a9871.jpg[/img]
Casual Mode is a way for players to practice and have fun in a less intense environment than standard Battle Royale Matches.

You can play up to 3 matches per day in Solo, Duo, or Squads and will drop into Erangel with a maximum of 12 players per match, with bots filling the remaining space.

Whether you're looking to warm up or just let of some steam in a more relaxed environment, Casual Mode is there to help!

newsitems.title: Welcome to Krafton ID
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Welcome to Krafton ID[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/78f33ef1371aedcc0e95509cafce1e5cc2e75b3d.jpg[/img]

Krafton Inc. is expanding its world with new games and experiences, and we would like to extend this new expanding world to our players. We are very excited to introduce to you Krafton ID, our integrated account system for Krafton games and services.

Registering for your Krafton ID grants you access to information about Krafton games as well as an added benefit of security for your game identity. We are currently developing perks, giveaways and more exclusively for Krafton ID account holders. 

Good news if you’re a PUBG Account holder, you are already registered for a Krafton ID! All you have to do is log in using your PUBG Account information. The PUBG Account program has been folded in Krafton ID.  
We will be launching the new Krafton ID program on September 8, 2021 (EST)!

[h2][b]FAQ[/b][/h2]
[olist]    [*]What is Krafton ID?        [list]            [*]Krafton ID is an integrated account system shared by games Krafton Inc. publishes. As of now, PUBG is the only game that uses Krafton ID, but there are existing and new games with a plan to use Krafton ID in the future.[/*]            [*]Krafton ID will live in [url=http://accounts.krafton.com/]accounts.krafton.com[/url], a brand new website that will provide all accounts-related services for Krafton game players.[/*]            [*]Players can link various game platforms and online services with their Krafton ID to enjoy promotional partnerships and drops.[/*]            [*]Krafton ID will be used to power security features that better protect player's valuable private information.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]What happens to my PUBG Account?        [list]            [*]If you already have a PUBG Account, it will automatically be converted to Krafton ID. You will be able to log into Krafton ID with the same email address and password that you used for PUBG Account.[/*]            [*]All of the rewards you received through PUBG Account will remain unchanged. [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Do I need to take any action regarding my PUBG Account?        [list]            [*]No. Your PUBG Account will be converted to Krafton ID automatically without a need for you to take an action.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Is my personal information being transferred?        [list]            [*]There will be no transfer of your personal or game data. Any information linked to your old PUBG Account will be stored and managed by the same entity within Krafton.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]What difference does this change make?        [list]            [*]The purpose of this rebranding is to provide a place where any Krafton game user can come for account and security services to play the games. [/*]            [*]This change will also unlock opportunities for Krafton to devise and provide creative promotional programs and perks to enrich player experiences for existing and future Krafton games.[/*]            [*]Krafton ID will evolve to be a critical piece of our service including cross-game features that allow Krafton to provide a more versatile and flexible player experience.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/olist]
We are excited about this change that will unlock the potential of what an accounts system can power--from promotions to cross-title services. See you at [url=http://accounts.krafton.com/]accounts.krafton.com[/url] soon!

The PUBG Team.

newsitems.title: En route for the global champions, welcome to PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES 5
newsitems.author: Hawkinz
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1455fec2e45d3a0b70933aa4d229e83216adb831.png[/img]
Hello, PUBG Esports Fans! 

Welcome back to PUBG Esports, with the fifth tournament of the PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES (PCS)!

PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES 5 is a crucial global event in the PUBG Esports ecosystem, as players fight for precious points required to advance to the PUBG Global Championship later this year.  

Read on for full details and regional schedule. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/679b05541058cc6eaff4f13389a83cc92eb4eec4.jpg[/img]
PCS5 will be held across four regions, with matches beginning on September 16 for the Americas and APAC, followed by Europe and Asia starting on September 18.
[list][*] Asia –  Korea, Japan, China, and Chinese Taipei
[*] Asia Pacific – Southeast Asia and Oceania
[*] Americas - North America and Latin America
[*] Europe - Europe, Middle East, and Africa[/list][h2][b]Tournament Schedule[/b][/h2][list][*]Asia Pacific / Americas
[list][*]September 16-17
[*]September 23-24
[*]September 30 - October 1[/list][*]Asia / Europe
[list][*]September 18-19
[*]September 25-26
[*]October 2-3[/list][/list][h2][b]Total Matches[/b][/h2]
[list][*]36 matches in total per region (6 matches per day)[/list][h2][b]The Prize Pool[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3571fe608d1e8670245a0c9490257a4d6ec1c7ba.jpg[/img]
The PCS5 prize pool starts at 1 million USD, split evenly across the four participating regions. Similar to previous events, 30% of all PCS5 item sales contribute towards the total prize pool via crowdfunding.

In a nutshell:
[list][*] Each region starts with a base prize pool of 250,000 USD
[*] 30% of PUBG's net sales of PCS5 items is shared directly with participating teams[/list][h2][b]Prize Pool[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Basic Prize : $230,000
[list][*] Week 1: $60,000
[*] Week 2: $70,000
[*] Week 3: $100,000[/list][/list][list][*]Special Prizes: $20,000
[list][*]KILL LEADER ($5,000)
[*]Prize granted to the player with the most kills
[*]Prize will be distributed evenly in the case of a tie[/list][*]ALL-PCS TEAM ($10,000)[list][*]
Prize granted to 4 best performing players in the Series[/list][*]INSANE SQUAD ($5,000)[list][*]Prize granted to the team which showed the most impressive moment in the Series[/list][*]Winner of the Special prize will be carefully chosen by the selection group.[/list][h2][b]PCS5 Pick'em Challenge[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0387187ef66beee2743e81a1094e322f755038e2.jpg[/img]
The Pick'em Challenge event is back with the return of the PCS5!

[b]PCS5 Items sales period[/b]
[list][*] PC: September 8, 2021 - September 30, 2021 1700 KST
[*] Console: September 16, 2021 1100 KST - October 20, 2021 1100 KST[/list][b]PCS5 Pick'em Challenge event period[/b]
[list][*] September 8, 2021 - September 30, 2021 1800 KST[/list][b]PCS5 Pick'em reward claiming period[/b][list][*] October 5, 2021 - October 20, 2021 1100 KST[/list]
[b]Esports shop sales period[/b][list][*] September 8, 2021 - October 20, 2021 1100 KST[/list]
Stay tuned to witness the crucial moments of PCS5, en route to the 2021 PUBG Global Championship later this year. Watch and participate in the live event, when PCS5 begins on September 16!

For everything PUBG Esports, visit [url=https://pubgesports.com]PUBGEsports.com[/url].
